结果已经明确了一半：

CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_LOG_LEVEL：当前 Kconfig 整段缺失，upstream 有完整配置，因此 .config 无法生成该值。
sys_startup_fn()：两个 esp_start.c 完全相同；但当前版本缺少 upstream 中声明该函数的 esp_start.h，所以出现隐式声明。

还需确认 Kconfig 插入位置，以及 upstream 如何包含 esp_start.h。执行下面的只读命令：

cd ~/openvela-work/contest284/nuttx

echo "=== 当前 Kconfig 330-430 ==="
sed -n '330,430p' \
  arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/Kconfig

echo "=== upstream Kconfig 330-430 ==="
sed -n '330,430p' \
  ~/openvela-work/upstream/nuttx/arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/Kconfig

echo "=== Kconfig 局部差异 ==="
diff -u \
  <(sed -n '320,440p' arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/Kconfig) \
  <(sed -n '320,440p' ~/openvela-work/upstream/nuttx/arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/Kconfig) \
  | sed -n '1,260p'

echo "=== esp_start.c 文件头 ==="
sed -n '20,70p' \
  arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/esp_start.c

echo "=== upstream esp_start.c 文件头 ==="
sed -n '20,70p' \
  ~/openvela-work/upstream/nuttx/arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/esp_start.c

echo "=== esp_start.h 是否存在 ==="
ls -l \
  arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/esp_start.h \
  ~/openvela-work/upstream/nuttx/arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/esp_start.h \
  2>&1

echo "=== 谁包含 esp_start.h ==="
grep -Rns --include='*.c' --include='*.h' --include='Make.defs' \
  'esp_start.h' \
  arch/risc-v/src \
  ~/openvela-work/upstream/nuttx/arch/risc-v/src 2>/dev/null \
  | sed -n '1,100p'

暂时不要直接在 .config 里写：

CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_LOG_LEVEL=0

因为它会在重新配置时丢失。正确做法应是恢复 upstream 的 Kconfig 配置块，让 olddefconfig 自动生成；sys_startup_fn() 也优先恢复 upstream 的正式头文件声明，而不是随手在 .c 中增加声明。

文档
思考了 25s

现在可以确认：

esp_start.c 已正确包含 esp_start.h。
当前 esp_start.h 是旧版本，缺少 sys_startup_fn() 声明。
CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_LOG_LEVEL 整个配置块确实没有进入当前 Kconfig。
当前和 upstream 的 Kconfig 排列差异很大，不能直接按 upstream 行号复制，否则可能再次破坏菜单结构。

再做最后一次只读定位：

cd ~/openvela-work/contest284/nuttx

echo "=== esp_start.h 完整差异 ==="
diff -u \
  arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/esp_start.h \
  ~/openvela-work/upstream/nuttx/arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/esp_start.h \
  | sed -n '1,240p'

echo "=== 当前 Kconfig 菜单结构及关键配置 ==="
grep -nE \
  '^menu |^endmenu|^config ESPRESSIF_(SIMPLE_BOOT|BOOTLOADER|CPU_FREQ|MAX_CPU_FREQ|MIN_CPU_FREQ|LOG_LEVEL)' \
  arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/Kconfig \
  | sed -n '1,260p'

echo "=== upstream Kconfig 菜单结构及关键配置 ==="
grep -nE \
  '^menu |^endmenu|^config ESPRESSIF_(SIMPLE_BOOT|BOOTLOADER|CPU_FREQ|MAX_CPU_FREQ|MIN_CPU_FREQ|LOG_LEVEL)' \
  ~/openvela-work/upstream/nuttx/arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/Kconfig \
  | sed -n '1,260p'

echo "=== 当前 SIMPLE_BOOT 附近 ==="
grep -n -B15 -A30 \
  '^config ESPRESSIF_SIMPLE_BOOT' \
  arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/Kconfig

echo "=== 当前第一个外设配置前后 ==="
grep -n -B12 -A12 \
  '^config ESPRESSIF_TWAI0' \
  arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/Kconfig

完成这一步后，修复应当是：

从 upstream 精确移植 esp_start.h 中缺少的函数声明；
将官方 Espressif Log Level 配置块插入当前 Kconfig 的正确菜单边界；
执行 make olddefconfig，由 Kconfig 自动生成 CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_LOG_LEVEL=0；
再清理编译。

不会直接硬编码 .config，也不会整份覆盖当前 openvela 的 Kconfig。

粘贴的文本 (1)(20260809-051756).txt
文档
思考了 1m 9s

现在证据充分，可以做两个精确移植：

esp_start.h 与 upstream 只有 SPDX 和 sys_startup_fn() 声明不同，因此可直接同步该头文件。
Log Level 配置块应插在当前 Bootloader and Image Configuration 菜单之前，位置与 upstream 一致。

先同步头文件：

cd ~/openvela-work/contest284/nuttx

cp \
  ~/openvela-work/upstream/nuttx/arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/esp_start.h \
  arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/esp_start.h

再提取并插入 upstream 的官方 Log Level 配置块：

P4_LOG_BLOCK=/tmp/esp32p4_log_level.kconfig

sed -n \
  '/^menu "Espressif Log Level"$/,/^endmenu # Espressif Log Level$/p' \
  ~/openvela-work/upstream/nuttx/arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/Kconfig \
  > "$P4_LOG_BLOCK"

wc -l "$P4_LOG_BLOCK"

P4_BOOT_LINE=$(grep -n \
  '^menu "Bootloader and Image Configuration"$' \
  arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/Kconfig \
  | head -1 | cut -d: -f1)

echo "Bootloader menu line: $P4_BOOT_LINE"

sed -i \
  "$((P4_BOOT_LINE - 1))r $P4_LOG_BLOCK" \
  arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/Kconfig

确认没有重复插入：

grep -c '^menu "Espressif Log Level"$' \
  arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/Kconfig

grep -c '^config ESPRESSIF_LOG_LEVEL$' \
  arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/Kconfig

grep -n -B3 -A5 '^config ESPRESSIF_LOG_LEVEL$' \
  arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/Kconfig

git diff --check

前两个计数都必须为 1。

然后让 Kconfig 自动生成配置：

make olddefconfig

验证：

grep -E \
  '^CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_LOG_LEVEL(_NONE)?=' \
  .config

grep -E \
  '^#define CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_LOG_LEVEL(_NONE)? ' \
  include/nuttx/config.h

L0 无调试日志配置下，预计得到：

CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_LOG_LEVEL_NONE=y
CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_LOG_LEVEL=0

最后重新构建：

make clean

make -j2 2>&1 \
  | tee ~/openvela-work/logs/contest284_esp32p4_build11.log

+ * Name: recalib_bbpll
+ *
+ * Description:

+ * Input Parameters:

+static void IRAM_ATTR NOINLINE_ATTR recalib_bbpll(void)
+{
+    rtc_cpu_freq_config_t old_config;
+    rtc_clk_cpu_freq_get_config(&old_config);
+
+  if (old_config.source == SOC_CPU_CLK_SRC_PLL
+#ifdef CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_ESP32H2
+      || old_config.source == SOC_CPU_CLK_SRC_FLASH_PLL
+#endif
+      )
+    {
+      rtc_clk_cpu_freq_set_xtal();
+      rtc_clk_cpu_freq_set_config(&old_config);

+++ b/components/riscv/interrupt_clic.c

+/*
+ * SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2023-2024 Espressif Systems (Shanghai) CO LTD
+ *
+ * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+ */
+#include <stdint.h>
+#include "riscv/rv_utils.h"
+#include "hal/interrupt_clic_ll.h"
+#include "esp_private/interrupt_clic.h"
+
+
+void intr_matrix_route(int intr_src, int intr_num)
+{
+    assert_valid_rv_int_num(intr_num);
+
+    const int core_id = rv_utils_get_core_id();
+    interrupt_clic_ll_route(core_id, intr_src, intr_num + RV_EXTERNAL_INT_OFFSET);
+}
+
+
+enum intr_type esprv_int_get_type(int rv_int_num)
+{
+    return interrupt_clic_ll_get_type(rv_int_num + RV_EXTERNAL_INT_OFFSET) ? INTR_TYPE_EDGE : INTR_TYPE_LEVEL;
+}
+
+
+int esprv_int_get_priority(int rv_int_num)
+{
+    return interrupt_clic_ll_get_priority(rv_int_num + RV_EXTERNAL_INT_OFFSET);
+}
+
+
+bool esprv_int_is_vectored(int rv_int_num)
+{
+    return interrupt_clic_ll_is_vectored(rv_int_num + RV_EXTERNAL_INT_OFFSET);
+}
+
+
+void esprv_int_set_vectored(int rv_int_num, bool vectored)
+{
+    interrupt_clic_ll_set_vectored(rv_int_num + RV_EXTERNAL_INT_OFFSET, vectored);
+}

+/****************************************************************************

+ *

+ *   A negated errno is returned on failure.

+  DEBUGASSERT(cpuint >= 0 && cpuint < ESP_NCPUINTS);

+
+  int irq = CPUINT_GETIRQ(g_cpuint_map[cpuint]);

**结论**

ESP32P4 应使用公开的 `esprv_int_*` 接口，包含头文件：

```c
#include "riscv/interrupt.h"
```

当前 [esp_irq.c](/home/benson/openvela-work/contest284/nuttx/arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/esp_irq.c:46) 已包含正确头文件，工作树中的 8 处改名方向正确。

**API 对应关系**

声明位于 `components/riscv/include/riscv/interrupt.h`：

- `esprv_int_enable(uint32_t)`：63
- `esprv_int_disable(uint32_t)`：72
- `esprv_int_set_type(int, enum intr_type)`：85
- `esprv_int_get_type(int)`：96
- `esprv_int_set_priority(int, int)`：103
- `esprv_int_set_threshold(int)`：121

其中五个写接口由 `components/riscv/ld/rom.api.ld:8-12` 显式映射到 ROM 旧符号：

```text
esprv_int_set_priority  -> esprv_intc_int_set_priority
esprv_int_set_threshold -> esprv_intc_int_set_threshold
esprv_int_enable        -> esprv_intc_int_enable
esprv_int_disable       -> esprv_intc_int_disable
esprv_int_set_type      -> esprv_intc_int_set_type
```

因此这五组参数和底层语义一一对应。旧名没有 C 头文件声明，不应由调用方直接使用。

`get_type` 是例外：`esprv_intc_int_get_type` 在当前 HAL 中无声明、无定义、无 ROM 符号。正确实现是 `components/riscv/interrupt_clic.c:21-24` 的 `esprv_int_get_type()`。

**P4 选择依据**

- `components/soc/esp32p4/include/soc/soc_caps.h:190-193`：P4 有 32 个 CPU 中断且 `SOC_INT_CLIC_SUPPORTED=1`。
- `components/riscv/include/riscv/interrupt.h:22-28`：据此选择 CLIC 私有实现。
- `hal_esp32p4.mk:393`：编译 `interrupt_clic.c`。
- `hal_esp32p4.mk:201`：链接上述 ROM API alias 脚本。
- `interrupt_clic.c:21-24` 会自动加 `RV_EXTERNAL_INT_OFFSET=16`，调用方仍传逻辑 CPU 中断号 `0..31`。

**两个语义风险**

1. 阈值不能保留硬编码 `1`。P4 的 `riscv/csr_clic.h:11-16` 明确 CLIC 会屏蔽所有 `priority <= threshold` 的中断，因此启用默认 priority 1 应传 `RVHAL_INTR_ENABLE_THRESH`，其值为 `0`。工作树现已这样修改。

2. [esp_irq.c:634](/home/benson/openvela-work/contest284/nuttx/arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/esp_irq.c:634) 仍是：

```c
is_edge = esprv_int_get_type(cpuint) == INTR_TYPE_LEVEL;
```

这与枚举、CLIC LL 返回语义和随后“Clear edge interrupts”注释相反，逻辑上应比较 `INTR_TYPE_EDGE`。本地 upstream 同样保留了这个疑似错误，建议作为独立运行时修复处理。

另有潜在范围问题：`esp_irq.h:75-93` 暴露 priority 1..15，而 P4 CLIC `NLBITS=3`、HAL 文档范围为 1..7；当前驱动实际都使用默认值 1，暂不触发。"}},{"agent_name":"/root/uart_audit","agent_status":"running"}]}

   194	/****************************************************************************
   195	 * Name: esp_lowputc_disable_all_uart_int
   196	 *
   197	 * Description:
   198	 *   Disable all UART interrupts.
   199	 *
   200	 * Parameters:
   201	 *   priv           - Pointer to the private driver struct.
   202	 *   current_status - Pointer to a variable to store the current status of
   203	 *                    the interrupt enable register before disabling
   204	 *                    UART interrupts.
   205	 *
   206	 ****************************************************************************/
   207	
   208	void esp_lowputc_disable_all_uart_int(struct esp_uart_s *priv,
   209	                                      uint32_t *current_status)
   210	{
   211	  irqstate_t flags;
   212	
   213	  flags = spin_lock_irqsave(&priv->lock);
   214	
   215	  if (current_status != NULL)
   216	    {
   217	      /* Save current status */
   218	
   219	      *current_status = uart_hal_get_intr_ena_status(priv->hal);
   220	    }
   221	
   222	  /* Disable all UART int */
   223	
   224	  uart_hal_disable_intr_mask(priv->hal, UINT32_MAX);
   225	
   226	  /* Clear all ints */
   227	
   228	  uart_hal_clr_intsts_mask(priv->hal, UINT32_MAX);
   229	
   230	  spin_unlock_irqrestore(&priv->lock, flags);
   231	}

   350	/****************************************************************************
   351	 * Name: esp_setup
   352	 *
   353	 * Description:
   354	 *   Configure the UART baud, bits, parity, fifos, etc. This method is
   355	 *   called the first time that the serial port is opened.
   356	 *   For the serial console, this will occur very early in initialization,
   357	 *   for other serial ports this will occur when the port is first opened.
   358	 *   This setup does not include attaching or enabling interrupts.
   359	 *   That portion of the UART setup is performed when the attach() method
   360	 *   is called.
   361	 *
   362	 * Input Parameters:
   363	 *   dev           - Pointer to the serial driver struct.
   364	 *
   365	 * Returned Values:
   366	 *   Zero (OK) is returned.
   367	 *
   368	 ****************************************************************************/
   369	
   370	static int esp_setup(uart_dev_t *dev)
   371	{
   372	  struct esp_uart_s *priv = dev->priv;
   373	  uint32_t sclk_freq;
   374	
   375	  /* Enable the UART Clock */
   376	
   377	  esp_lowputc_enable_sysclk(priv);
   378	
   379	  esp_clk_tree_src_get_freq_hz((soc_module_clk_t)UART_SCLK_DEFAULT,
   380	                           ESP_CLK_TREE_SRC_FREQ_PRECISION_CACHED,
   381	                           &sclk_freq);
   382	
   383	  /* Initialize UART module */
   384	
   385	  uart_hal_init(priv->hal, priv->id);
   386	  uart_hal_set_mode(priv->hal, UART_MODE_UART);
   387	  uart_hal_set_sclk(priv->hal, UART_SCLK_DEFAULT);
   388	  uart_hal_set_baudrate(priv->hal, priv->baud, sclk_freq);
   389	  uart_hal_set_parity(priv->hal, priv->parity);
   390	  set_data_length(priv);
   391	  set_stop_length(priv);
   392	  uart_hal_set_tx_idle_num(priv->hal, 0);
   393	
   394	  /* Define 0 as the threshold that means TX FIFO buffer is empty. */
   395	
   396	  uart_hal_set_txfifo_empty_thr(priv->hal, 10);
   397	
   398	  /* Define a threshold to trigger an RX FIFO FULL interrupt.
   399	   * Define just one byte to read data immediately.
   400	   */
   401	
   402	  uart_hal_set_rxfifo_full_thr(priv->hal, 120);
   403	
   404	#if defined(CONFIG_SERIAL_IFLOWCONTROL) || \
   405	    defined(CONFIG_SERIAL_OFLOWCONTROL)
   406	  uart_hw_flowcontrol_t flow_ctrl = UART_HW_FLOWCTRL_DISABLE;
   407	  uint32_t rx_thrs = 0;
   408	
   409	#ifdef CONFIG_SERIAL_IFLOWCONTROL
   410	  /* Configure the input flow control */
   411	
   412	  if (priv->iflow)
   413	    {
   414	      /* Enable input flow control and set the RX FIFO threshold
   415	       * to assert the RTS line to half the RX FIFO buffer.
   416	       * It will then save some space on the hardware fifo to
   417	       * remaining bytes that may arrive after RTS be asserted
   418	       * and before the transmitter stops sending data.
   419	       */
   420	
   421	      flow_ctrl |= UART_HW_FLOWCTRL_RTS;
   422	      rx_thrs = SOC_UART_FIFO_LEN / 2;
   423	    }
   424	#endif
   425	
   426	#ifdef CONFIG_SERIAL_OFLOWCONTROL
   427	  /* Configure the output flow control */
   428	
   429	  if (priv->oflow)
   430	    {
   431	      flow_ctrl |= UART_HW_FLOWCTRL_CTS;
   432	    }
   433	#endif
   434	
   435	  uart_hal_set_hw_flow_ctrl(priv->hal, flow_ctrl, rx_thrs);
   436	#endif /* CONFIG_SERIAL_IFLOWCONTROL || CONFIG_SERIAL_OFLOWCONTROL */
   437	
   438	  /* Clear FIFOs */
   439	
   440	  uart_hal_rxfifo_rst(priv->hal);
   441	  uart_hal_txfifo_rst(priv->hal);
   442	
   443	  return OK;
   444	}

   148	 * @brief  Configure the lp uart baud-rate.
   149	 *
   150	 * @param  hw Beginning address of the peripheral registers.
   151	 * @param  baud The baud rate to be set.
   152	 * @param  sclk_freq Frequency of the clock source of UART, in Hz.
   153	 *
   154	 * @return True if baud-rate set successfully; False if baud-rate requested cannot be achieved
   155	 */
   156	FORCE_INLINE_ATTR bool lp_uart_ll_set_baudrate(uart_dev_t *hw, uint32_t baud, uint32_t sclk_freq)
   157	{
   158	    if (baud == 0) {
   159	        return false;
   160	    }
   161	    // No pre-divider for LP UART clock source on the target
   162	    uint32_t clk_div = (sclk_freq << 4) / baud;
   163	    // The baud rate configuration register is divided into an integer part and a fractional part.
   164	    uint32_t clkdiv_int = clk_div >> 4;
   165	    if (clkdiv_int > UART_CLKDIV_V) {
   166	        return false; // unachievable baud-rate
   167	    }
   168	    uint32_t clkdiv_frag = clk_div & 0xf;
   169	    hw->clkdiv_sync.clkdiv = clkdiv_int;
   170	    hw->clkdiv_sync.clkdiv_frag = clkdiv_frag;
   171	    uart_ll_update(hw);
   172	    return true;
   173	}

+/****************************************************************************
+ * Name: nxsched_timeout
+ *
+ * Description:
+ *   A timeout elapsed while waiting for timeout.
+ *
+ * Assumptions:
+ *   This function executes in the context of the timer interrupt handler.
+ *   Local interrupts are assumed to be disabled on entry.
+ *
+ * Input Parameters:
+ *   arg - Parameter to pass to wdentry.
+ *
+ ****************************************************************************/
+
+static void nxsched_timeout(wdparm_t arg)
+{
+  FAR struct tcb_s *wtcb;
+  irqstate_t flags;
+
+  /* Get waiting tcb from parameter */
+
+  wtcb = (FAR struct tcb_s *)(uintptr_t)arg;
+
+  /* We must be in a critical section in order to call up_switch_context()
+   * below.
+   */
+
+  flags = enter_critical_section();
+
+  /* There may be a race condition -- make sure the task is
+   * still waiting for a signal
+   */
+
+  if (wtcb->task_state == TSTATE_WAIT_SIG)
+    {
+      FAR struct tcb_s *rtcb = this_task();
+
+      /* Remove the task from waiting list */
+
+      dq_rem((FAR dq_entry_t *)wtcb, list_waitingforsignal());
+
+      /* Add the task to ready-to-run task list, and
+       * perform the context switch if one is needed
+       */
+
+      if (nxsched_add_readytorun(wtcb))
+        {
+          up_switch_context(this_task(), rtcb);
+        }
+    }
+
+  leave_critical_section(flags);
+}
+
+/****************************************************************************
+ * Name: nxsched_ticksleep
+ *
+ * Description:
+ *   The nxsched_ticksleep() function will cause the calling thread to be
+ *   suspended from execution for the specified number of system ticks.
+ *
+ *   It can only be resumed through scheduler operations.
+ *
+ * Input Parameters:
+ *   ticks - The number of system ticks to sleep.
+ *
+ * Returned Value:
+ *   None
+ *
+ ****************************************************************************/
+
+void nxsched_ticksleep(unsigned int ticks)
+{
+  FAR struct tcb_s *rtcb;
+  irqstate_t flags;
+
+  if (ticks == 0)
+    {
+      sched_yield();
+      return;
+    }
+
+  flags = enter_critical_section();
+
+  rtcb = this_task();
+
+  wd_start(&rtcb->waitdog, ticks, nxsched_timeout, (uintptr_t)rtcb);
+
+  /* Remove the tcb task from the ready-to-run list. */
+
+  nxsched_remove_self(rtcb);
+
+  /* Add the task to the specified blocked task list */
+
+  rtcb->task_state = TSTATE_WAIT_SIG;
+  dq_addlast((FAR dq_entry_t *)rtcb, &g_waitingforsignal);
+
+  /* Now, perform the context switch if one is needed */
+
+  up_switch_context(this_task(), rtcb);
+
+  wd_cancel(&rtcb->waitdog);
+
+  leave_critical_section(flags);
+}

   418	/****************************************************************************
   419	 * Name: esp_os_intr_alloc_intrstatus
   420	 *
   421	 * Description:
   422	 *   Allocate an interrupt handler with interrupt status register.  Mirrors
   423	 *   the semantics of ESP-IDF's esp_intr_alloc_intrstatus(): the interrupt
   424	 *   is enabled before returning, unless ESP_INTR_FLAG_INTRDISABLED is set
   425	 *   in flags, in which case the caller is expected to enable it later via
   426	 *   esp_intr_enable()/up_enable_irq().
   427	 *
   428	 * Input Parameters:
   429	 *   source         - Interrupt source.
   430	 *   flags          - Interrupt flags (ESP_INTR_FLAG_*).
   431	 *   intrstatusreg  - Interrupt status register.
   432	 *   intrstatusmask - Interrupt status mask.
   433	 *   handler        - Interrupt handler function.
   434	 *   arg            - User argument.
   435	 *   ret_handle     - Pointer to receive the interrupt handle.
   436	 *
   437	 * Returned Value:
   438	 *   ESP_OK on success; error code on failure.
   439	 *
   440	 ****************************************************************************/
   441	
   442	esp_err_t esp_os_intr_alloc_intrstatus(int source, int flags,
   443	                                        uint32_t intrstatusreg,
   444	                                        uint32_t intrstatusmask,
   445	                                        esp_os_intr_handler_t handler,
   446	                                        FAR void *arg,
   447	                                        FAR intr_handle_t *ret_handle)
   448	{
   449	  FAR struct intr_adapter_to_nuttx *isr_adapter_args;
   450	  int irq = ESP_SOURCE2IRQ(source);
   451	  int cpuint;
   452	
   453	  isr_adapter_args = kmm_calloc(1, sizeof(struct intr_adapter_to_nuttx));
   454	  if (isr_adapter_args == NULL)
   455	    {
   456	      irqerr("Failed to kmm_calloc\n");
   457	      return ESP_ERR_NO_MEM;
   458	    }
   459	
   460	  isr_adapter_args->handler = handler;
   461	  isr_adapter_args->arg     = arg;
   462	
   463	  cpuint = esp_setup_irq_with_flags_intrstatus(source, flags, intrstatusreg,
   464	                                               intrstatusmask,
   465	                                               isr_adapter_func,
   466	                                               isr_adapter_args);
   467	
   468	  if (cpuint < 0)
   469	    {
   470	      irqerr("Failed to setup interrupt\n");
   471	      return ESP_ERR_NOT_FOUND;
   472	    }
   473	
   474	  *ret_handle = esp_get_handle(this_cpu(), irq);
   475	
   476	  if (*ret_handle == NULL)
   477	    {
   478	      irqerr("Failed to get handle\n");
   479	      return ESP_ERR_NOT_FOUND;
   480	    }
   481	
   482	  /* Honour ESP_INTR_FLAG_INTRDISABLED: return with the interrupt disabled
   483	   * so the caller can enable it explicitly once its ISR context is fully
   484	   * initialised (matches ESP-IDF's esp_intr_alloc() behaviour).
   485	   */
   486	
   487	  if ((flags & ESP_INTR_FLAG_INTRDISABLED) == 0)
   488	    {
   489	      up_enable_irq(irq);
   490	    }
   491	
   492	  return ESP_OK;
   493	}

   645	        {
   646	          _err("Failed to set nonblock flag\n");

   648	        }
   649	    }
   650	
   651	  if (hptw != NULL)
   652	    {

   654	    }
   655	
   656	  ret = esp_os_queue_receive_generic(queue, item, 0);

   658	  /* Restore the original flags. */
   659

   662	    {
   663	      _err("Failed to clear nonblock flag\n");
   664	      return ESP_FAIL;
   665	    }
   666	
   667	  return ret;

+/****************************************************************************
+ * Name: esp_os_queue_send_generic
+ *
+ * Description:
+ *   Generic function to send a message to a queue.
+ *
+ * Input Parameters:
+ *   queue - Queue handle.
+ *   item  - Pointer to the item to be sent.
+ *   ticks - Ticks to wait.
+ *   prio  - Priority of the message.
+ *
+ * Returned Value:
+ *   ESP_OK on success; ESP_FAIL on failure.
+ *
+ ****************************************************************************/
+
+static esp_err_t esp_os_queue_send_generic(esp_os_queue_handle_t queue,
+                                           FAR void *item,
+                                           uint32_t ticks,
+                                           int prio)
+{
+  int ret;
+  struct timespec timeout;
+  FAR struct mq_adpt *mq_adpt = (FAR struct mq_adpt *)queue;
+
+  if (ticks == OS_PORT_MAX_DELAY || ticks == 0)
+    {
+      ret = file_mq_send(&mq_adpt->mq, (FAR const char *)item,
+                         mq_adpt->msgsize, prio);
+      if (ret < 0)
+        {
+          _err("Failed to send message to mqueue error=%d\n", ret);
+        }
+    }
+  else
+    {
+      ret = clock_gettime(CLOCK_REALTIME, &timeout);
+      if (ret < 0)
+        {
+          _err("Failed to get time\n");
+          return false;
+        }
+
+      if (ticks)
+        {
+          struct timespec ts;
+
+          clock_ticks2time(&ts, ticks);
+          clock_timespec_add(&timeout, &ts, &timeout);
+        }
+
+      ret = file_mq_timedsend(&mq_adpt->mq, (FAR const char *)item,
+                              mq_adpt->msgsize, prio, &timeout);
+      if (ret < 0)
+        {
+          _err("Failed to timedsend message to mqueue error=%d\n", ret);
+        }
+    }
+
+  return ret == 0 ? ESP_OK : ESP_FAIL;
+}

+  ssize_t ret;
+  struct timespec timeout;
+  unsigned int prio;
+  FAR struct mq_adpt *mq_adpt = (FAR struct mq_adpt *)queue;

+    {
+      ret = file_mq_receive(&mq_adpt->mq, (FAR char *)item,
+                            mq_adpt->msgsize, &prio);
+      if (ret < 0 && ret != -EAGAIN)
+        {
+          _err("Failed to receive from mqueue error=%d\n", ret);
+        }
+    }
+  else
+    {
+      ret = clock_gettime(CLOCK_REALTIME, &timeout);
+      if (ret < 0)
+        {
+          _err("Failed to get time\n");
+          return false;
+        }
+
+      if (ticks)
+        {
+          struct timespec ts;
+
+          clock_ticks2time(&ts, ticks);
+          clock_timespec_add(&timeout, &ts, &timeout);

+      ret = file_mq_timedreceive(&mq_adpt->mq, (FAR char *)item,

+      if (ret < 0 && ret != -EAGAIN)

esp_err_t esp_timer_impl_init(intr_handler_t alarm_handler)
{
    if (s_timer_interrupt_handle[(ISR_HANDLERS == 1) ? 0 : OS_PORT_GET_CORE_ID()] != NULL) {
        ESP_EARLY_LOGE(TAG, "timer ISR is already initialized");
        return ESP_ERR_INVALID_STATE;
    }

    int isr_flags = ESP_INTR_FLAG_INTRDISABLED
                    | ((1 << CONFIG_ESP_TIMER_INTERRUPT_LEVEL) & ESP_INTR_FLAG_LEVELMASK)
#if !SOC_SYSTIMER_INT_LEVEL
                    | ESP_INTR_FLAG_EDGE
#endif
#if CONFIG_ESP_TIMER_IN_IRAM
                    | ESP_INTR_FLAG_IRAM
#endif
                    ;

    esp_err_t err = esp_os_intr_alloc(ETS_SYSTIMER_TARGET2_INTR_SOURCE, isr_flags,
                                      &timer_alarm_isr, NULL,
                                      &s_timer_interrupt_handle[(ISR_HANDLERS == 1) ? 0 : OS_PORT_GET_CORE_ID()]);
    if (err != ESP_OK) {
        ESP_EARLY_LOGE(TAG, "esp_intr_alloc failed (0x%x)", err);
        return err;
    }

    if (s_alarm_handler == NULL) {
        s_alarm_handler = alarm_handler;
        /* TODO: if SYSTIMER is used for anything else, access to SYSTIMER_INT_ENA_REG has to be
        * protected by a shared spinlock. Since this code runs as part of early startup, this
        * is practically not an issue.
        */
        systimer_hal_enable_alarm_int(&systimer_hal, SYSTIMER_ALARM_ESPTIMER);
    }

    err = esp_intr_enable(s_timer_interrupt_handle[(ISR_HANDLERS == 1) ? 0 : OS_PORT_GET_CORE_ID()]);
    if (err != ESP_OK) {
        ESP_EARLY_LOGE(TAG, "Can not enable ISR (0x%0x)", err);
    }

    return err;
}

void esp_timer_impl_deinit(void)
{
    systimer_ll_enable_alarm(systimer_hal.dev, SYSTIMER_ALARM_ESPTIMER, false);
    /* TODO: may need a spinlock, see the note related to SYSTIMER_INT_ENA_REG in systimer_hal_init */
    systimer_ll_enable_alarm_int(systimer_hal.dev, SYSTIMER_ALARM_ESPTIMER, false);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < ISR_HANDLERS; i++) {
        if (s_timer_interrupt_handle[i] != NULL) {
            esp_intr_disable(s_timer_interrupt_handle[i]);
            esp_intr_free(s_timer_interrupt_handle[i]);
            s_timer_interrupt_handle[i] = NULL;
        }
    }
    s_alarm_handler = NULL;
}

uint64_t esp_timer_impl_get_alarm_reg(void)
{
    esp_os_enter_critical_safe(&s_time_update_lock);
    uint64_t val = systimer_hal_get_alarm_value(&systimer_hal, SYSTIMER_ALARM_ESPTIMER);
#ifdef CONFIG_ESP_TIMER_SUPPORTS_ISR_DISPATCH_METHOD
    esp_timer_impl_try_to_set_next_alarm();
    // process timers with ISR dispatch method
    isr_timers_processed = timer_process_alarm(ESP_TIMER_ISR);
    xHigherPriorityTaskWoken = s_isr_dispatch_need_yield;
    s_isr_dispatch_need_yield = 0;
#endif

    if (isr_timers_processed == false) {
        esp_os_task_notify_give_from_isr(s_timer_task, &xHigherPriorityTaskWoken);
    }
    if (xHigherPriorityTaskWoken) {
        OS_PORT_YIELD_FROM_ISR();
    }
}

static ESP_TIMER_IRAM_ATTR inline bool is_initialized(void)
{
    return s_timer_task > 0;
}

static esp_err_t init_timer_task(void)
{
    esp_err_t err = ESP_OK;
    if (is_initialized()) {
        ESP_EARLY_LOGE(TAG, "Task is already initialized");
        err = ESP_ERR_INVALID_STATE;
    } else {
        int ret = esp_os_create_task_pinned_to_core(
                      (esp_os_task_function_t)&timer_task, "esp_timer",
                      ESP_TASK_TIMER_STACK, NULL, ESP_TASK_TIMER_PRIO,
                      &s_timer_task, CONFIG_ESP_TIMER_TASK_AFFINITY);
        if (ret != 0) {
            ESP_EARLY_LOGE(TAG, "Not enough memory to create timer task");
            err = ESP_ERR_NO_MEM;
        }
    }
    return err;
}

static void deinit_timer_task(void)
{
    if (s_timer_task > 0) {
        esp_os_task_delete(s_timer_task);
        s_timer_task = 0;
    }
}

/****************************************************************************
 * Included Files
 ****************************************************************************/

#include <nuttx/arch.h>
#include <nuttx/irq.h>
#include <nuttx/kmalloc.h>

#include "riscv_mtimer.h"

/****************************************************************************
 * Private Types
 ****************************************************************************/

/* This structure provides the private representation of the "lower-half"
 * driver state structure.  This structure must be cast-compatible with the
 * oneshot_lowerhalf_s structure.
 */

struct riscv_mtimer_lowerhalf_s
{
  struct oneshot_lowerhalf_s lower;
  uintreg_t                  mtime;
  uintreg_t                  mtimecmp;
  uint64_t                   freq;
  uint64_t                   alarm;
};

/****************************************************************************
 * Private Function Prototypes
 ****************************************************************************/

static int riscv_mtimer_max_delay(struct oneshot_lowerhalf_s *lower,
                                  struct timespec *ts);
static int riscv_mtimer_start(struct oneshot_lowerhalf_s *lower,
                              oneshot_callback_t callback, void *arg,
                              const struct timespec *ts);
static int riscv_mtimer_cancel(struct oneshot_lowerhalf_s *lower,
                               struct timespec *ts);
static int riscv_mtimer_current(struct oneshot_lowerhalf_s *lower,
                                struct timespec *ts);

/****************************************************************************
 * Private Data
 ****************************************************************************/

static const struct oneshot_operations_s g_riscv_mtimer_ops =
{
  .max_delay = riscv_mtimer_max_delay,
  .start     = riscv_mtimer_start,
  .cancel    = riscv_mtimer_cancel,
  .current   = riscv_mtimer_current,
};

/****************************************************************************
 * Private Functions
 ****************************************************************************/

static uint64_t riscv_mtimer_get_mtime(struct riscv_mtimer_lowerhalf_s *priv)
{
  return riscv_mtimer_get(priv->mtime);
}

static void riscv_mtimer_set_mtimecmp(struct riscv_mtimer_lowerhalf_s *priv,
                                      uint64_t value)
{
  riscv_mtimer_set(priv->mtime, priv->mtimecmp, value);
}

/****************************************************************************
 * Name: riscv_mtimer_max_delay
 *
 * Description:
 *   Determine the maximum delay of the one-shot timer
 *
 * Input Parameters:
 *   lower   An instance of the lower-half oneshot state structure.  This
 *           structure must have been previously initialized via a call to
 *           oneshot_initialize();
 *   ts      The location in which to return the maximum delay.
 *
 * Returned Value:
 *   Zero (OK) is returned on success; a negated errno value is returned
 *   on failure.
 *
 ****************************************************************************/

static int riscv_mtimer_max_delay(struct oneshot_lowerhalf_s *lower,
                                  struct timespec *ts)
{
  ts->tv_sec  = UINT32_MAX;
  ts->tv_nsec = NSEC_PER_SEC - 1;

  return 0;
}

/****************************************************************************
 * Name: riscv_mtimer_start
 *
 * Description:
 *   Start the oneshot timer
 *
 * Input Parameters:
 *   lower   An instance of the lower-half oneshot state structure.  This
 *           structure must have been previously initialized via a call to
 *           oneshot_initialize();
 *   handler The function to call when when the oneshot timer expires.
 *   arg     An opaque argument that will accompany the callback.
 *   ts      Provides the duration of the one shot timer.
 *
 * Returned Value:
 *   Zero (OK) is returned on success; a negated errno value is returned
 *   on failure.
 *
 ****************************************************************************/

static int riscv_mtimer_start(struct oneshot_lowerhalf_s *lower,
                              oneshot_callback_t callback, void *arg,
                              const struct timespec *ts)
{
  struct riscv_mtimer_lowerhalf_s *priv =
    (struct riscv_mtimer_lowerhalf_s *)lower;
  irqstate_t flags;
  uint64_t mtime;
  uint64_t alarm;

  flags = up_irq_save();

  mtime = riscv_mtimer_get_mtime(priv);
  alarm = mtime + ts->tv_sec * priv->freq +
          ts->tv_nsec * priv->freq / NSEC_PER_SEC;

  priv->alarm = alarm;

  riscv_mtimer_set_mtimecmp(priv, priv->alarm);

  up_irq_restore(flags);
  return 0;
}

/****************************************************************************
 * Name: riscv_mtimer_cancel
 *
 * Description:
 *   Cancel the oneshot timer and return the time remaining on the timer.
 *
 *   NOTE: This function may execute at a high rate with no timer running (as
 *   when pre-emption is enabled and disabled).
 *
 * Input Parameters:
 *   lower   Caller allocated instance of the oneshot state structure.  This
 *           structure must have been previously initialized via a call to
 *           oneshot_initialize();
 *   ts      The location in which to return the time remaining on the
 *           oneshot timer.  A time of zero is returned if the timer is
 *           not running.
 *
 * Returned Value:
 *   Zero (OK) is returned on success.  A call to up_timer_cancel() when
 *   the timer is not active should also return success; a negated errno
 *   value is returned on any failure.
 *
 ****************************************************************************/

static int riscv_mtimer_cancel(struct oneshot_lowerhalf_s *lower,
                               struct timespec *ts)
{
  struct riscv_mtimer_lowerhalf_s *priv =
    (struct riscv_mtimer_lowerhalf_s *)lower;
  uint64_t mtime;
  uint64_t alarm;
  uint64_t nsec;
  irqstate_t flags;

  flags = up_irq_save();

  alarm = priv->alarm;

  mtime = riscv_mtimer_get_mtime(priv);

  riscv_mtimer_set_mtimecmp(priv, mtime + UINT64_MAX);

  nsec = (alarm - mtime) * NSEC_PER_SEC / priv->freq;
  ts->tv_sec  = nsec / NSEC_PER_SEC;
  ts->tv_nsec = nsec % NSEC_PER_SEC;

  priv->alarm = 0;

  up_irq_restore(flags);

  return 0;
}

 *           is returned for the initialization moment.
 *
 * Returned Value:
 *   Zero (OK) is returned on success, a negated errno value is returned on
 *   any failure.
 *

ifeq ($(CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_FLASH_2M),y)
	FLASH_SIZE := 2MB
else ifeq ($(CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_FLASH_4M),y)
	FLASH_SIZE := 4MB
else ifeq ($(CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_FLASH_8M),y)
	FLASH_SIZE := 8MB
else ifeq ($(CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_FLASH_16M),y)
	FLASH_SIZE := 16MB
endif

ifeq ($(CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_FLASH_MODE_DIO),y)
	FLASH_MODE := dio
else ifeq ($(CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_FLASH_MODE_DOUT),y)
	FLASH_MODE := dout
else ifeq ($(CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_FLASH_MODE_QIO),y)
	FLASH_MODE := qio
else ifeq ($(CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_FLASH_MODE_QOUT),y)
	FLASH_MODE := qout
endif

ifeq ($(CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_FLASH_FREQ_80M),y)
	FLASH_FREQ := 80m
else ifeq ($(CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_FLASH_FREQ_48M),y)
	FLASH_FREQ := 48m
else ifeq ($(CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_FLASH_FREQ_40M),y)
	FLASH_FREQ := 40m
else ifeq ($(CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_FLASH_FREQ_26M),y)
	FLASH_FREQ := 26m
else ifeq ($(CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_FLASH_FREQ_20M),y)
	FLASH_FREQ := 20m
endif

ifeq ($(CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_FLASH_DETECT),y)
	ESPTOOL_WRITEFLASH_OPTS := -fs detect -fm dio -ff $(FLASH_FREQ)
else
	ESPTOOL_WRITEFLASH_OPTS := -fs $(FLASH_SIZE) -fm dio -ff $(FLASH_FREQ)
endif

# Configure the variables according to build environment

ESPTOOL_MIN_VERSION := 4.8.0

ifdef ESPTOOL_BINDIR
	ifeq ($(CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_BOOTLOADER_MCUBOOT),y)
		ifeq ($(CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_ESP32P4),y)
			BL_OFFSET := 0x2000
		else
			BL_OFFSET := 0x0000
		endif
		BOOTLOADER      := $(ESPTOOL_BINDIR)/mcuboot-$(CHIP_SERIES).bin
		FLASH_BL        := $(BL_OFFSET) $(BOOTLOADER)
		ESPTOOL_BINS    := $(FLASH_BL)
	endif
endif

ifeq ($(CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_BOOTLOADER_MCUBOOT),y)
	ifeq ($(CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_ESPTOOL_TARGET_PRIMARY),y)
		VERIFIED   := --confirm
		APP_OFFSET := $(CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_OTA_PRIMARY_SLOT_OFFSET)
	else ifeq ($(CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_ESPTOOL_TARGET_SECONDARY),y)
		VERIFIED   :=
		APP_OFFSET := $(CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_OTA_SECONDARY_SLOT_OFFSET)
	endif

	APP_IMAGE      := nuttx.bin
	FLASH_APP      := $(APP_OFFSET) $(APP_IMAGE)
	IMGTOOL_ALIGN_ARGS := --align 4

	ifeq ($(CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_ESP32P4),y)
		APP_OFFSET := 0x2000
	else
		APP_OFFSET := 0x0000
	endif
	APP_IMAGE      := nuttx.bin
	FLASH_APP      := $(APP_OFFSET) $(APP_IMAGE)
	ESPTOOL_BINDIR := .
endif

# MERGEBIN -- Merge raw binary files into a single file

define MERGEBIN
	@python3 tools/espressif/check_esptool.py -v $(ESPTOOL_MIN_VERSION)
	$(Q) if [ -z $(ESPTOOL_BINDIR) ]; then \
		echo "MERGEBIN error: Missing argument for binary files directory."; \
		echo "USAGE: make ESPTOOL_BINDIR=<dir>"; \
		exit 1; \
	fi
	$(Q) if [ -z $(FLASH_SIZE) ]; then \
		echo "Missing Flash memory size configuration."; \
		exit 1; \
	fi
	esptool.py -c $(CHIP_SERIES) merge_bin --output nuttx.merged.bin $(ESPTOOL_BINS)
	$(Q) echo nuttx.merged.bin >> nuttx.manifest
	$(Q) echo "Generated: nuttx.merged.bin"
endef

# MKIMAGE -- Convert an ELF file into a compatible binary file

ifeq ($(CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_BOOTLOADER_MCUBOOT),y)
define MKIMAGE
	$(Q) echo "MKIMAGE: NuttX binary"
	$(Q) if ! imgtool version 1>/dev/null 2>&1; then \
		echo ""; \
		echo "imgtool not found.  Please run: \"pip install imgtool\""; \
		echo ""; \
		echo "Run make again to create the nuttx.bin image."; \
		exit 1; \
	fi
	imgtool sign $(IMGTOOL_SIGN_ARGS) nuttx.hex nuttx.bin
	$(Q) echo nuttx.bin >> nuttx.manifest
	$(Q) echo "Generated: nuttx.bin (MCUboot compatible)"
endef
else
define MKIMAGE
	$(Q) echo "MKIMAGE: NuttX binary"
	@python3 tools/espressif/check_esptool.py -v $(ESPTOOL_MIN_VERSION)
	$(Q) if [ -z $(FLASH_SIZE) ]; then \
		echo "Missing Flash memory size configuration."; \
		exit 1; \
	fi
	$(eval ELF2IMAGE_OPTS := $(if $(CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_SIMPLE_BOOT),--ram-only-header) -fs $(FLASH_SIZE) -fm $(FLASH_MODE) -ff $(FLASH_FREQ))
	esptool.py -c $(CHIP_SERIES) elf2image $(ELF2IMAGE_OPTS) -o nuttx.bin nuttx
	$(Q) echo nuttx.bin >> nuttx.manifest
	$(Q) echo "Generated: nuttx.bin"
endef
endif

# POSTBUILD -- Perform post build operations

define POSTBUILD
	$(call MKIMAGE)
	$(if $(CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_MERGE_BINS),$(call MERGEBIN))
endef

ESPTOOL_BAUD ?= 921600

define FLASH

	esptool.py $(ESPTOOL_OPTS) write_flash $(WRITEFLASH_OPTS)
endef

L199: # 最小可运行 NSH 系统 defconfig 参考
L200: 
L201: [ cite77†English | 简体中文 ]
L202: 
L203: 本文档面向「新硬件适配赛道」的开发者，目标是帮助开发者在自己的开发板上先启动到 NSH 命令行提示符。建议的工作流是：先以本文给出的最小集启动，验证串口与 NSH 工作正常后，再按需逐步打开文件系统、网络、传感器等子系统。
L204: 
L205: ## 一、概述
L206: ### 1、文档目标
L207: 
L208: 参赛者拿到一块尚未适配 openvela 的开发板后，最关键的第一步是让系统能启动到 NSH 命令行提示符。本文档提供一份最小的 defconfig 参考，仅包含启动 NSH 所必需的配置项，便于参赛者：
L209: 
L210:   * 快速判断哪些 CONFIG 必须修改（与目标硬件强相关）；
L211:   * 哪些 CONFIG 可直接复用（与硬件无关的运行时支持）；
L212:   * 完成 L0 启动后，按子系统顺序增量启用功能。
L213: ### 2、推荐工作流
L214: 
L215:     `Step 0: 硬件就绪
L216:             - 目标芯片在 nuttx/arch/<arch>/src/<chip>/ 下已有支持
L217:             - 板级目录已建立 (boards/<arch>/<chip>/<board>/)
L218:             - 串口 TX/RX 引脚与上位机连通
L219:             ↓
L220:     Step 1: 套用本文最小集 → 编译 → 烧录 → 串口看到 NSH 提示符
L221:             ↓
L222:     Step 2: 按硬件能力增量启用子系统
L223:             - 文件系统 (FAT / LittleFS)
L224:             - 网络协议栈 (Ethernet / Wi-Fi)
L225:             - 图形 (LCD / framebuffer / LVGL)
L226:             - 传感 (uORB / I2C / SPI sensors)
L227:             ↓
L228:     Step 3: 移植稳定后做 release 瘦身
L229:             - 关闭 DEBUG_*、ALLSYMS 等调试项
L230:             - 调整 stack size 至实测需求
L231:     `
L232: ## 二、最小 NSH 必需配置
L233: 
L234: 本节配置项参考 `nuttx/boards/arm/stm32/nucleo-f303re/configs/nsh/defconfig`（35 行）整理而来，并参考了 Mateusz Szafoni 的 cite78†NuttX small systems 系列文章†www.railab.me 对最小化裁剪的实践经验。
L235: 
L236: ### 1、架构与板级标识（必须按目标硬件替换）
L237: 
L238:     `CONFIG_ARCH="arm"
L239:     CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP="stm32"
L240:     CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_STM32=y
L241:     CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_STM32F303RE=y
L242:     CONFIG_ARCH_BOARD="nucleo-f303re"
L243:     CONFIG_ARCH_BOARD_NUCLEO_F303RE=y
L244:     `
L245: #### 替换原则
L246: 
L247: 配置项  | 替换原则
L248: --- | ---
L249: `CONFIG_ARCH=`  | 目标 CPU 架构，例如 `"arm"`、`"arm64"`、`"risc-v"`、`"xtensa"`
L250: `CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP=` 与 `CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_<FAMILY>=y`  | 目标 SoC 家族，需与 `nuttx/arch/<arch>/src/<chip>/` 目录一致（如 `stm32`、`stm32h7`、`nrf52`、`esp32s3`）
L251: `CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_<DEVICE>=y`  | 具体型号，例如 `STM32F407VG`、`NRF52840`、`ESP32S3`
L252: `CONFIG_ARCH_BOARD=` 与 `CONFIG_ARCH_BOARD_<NAME>=y`  | 板级目录名，需与 `nuttx/boards/<arch>/<chip>/<board>/` 一致
L253: ### 2、内存布局（必须按目标硬件填写）
L254: 
L255:     `CONFIG_RAM_START=0x20000000
L256:     CONFIG_RAM_SIZE=65536
L257:     CONFIG_MM_REGIONS=2
L258:     CONFIG_BOARD_LOOPSPERMSEC=6522
L259:     `
L260: 
L261: #### 配置项说明
L262: 
L263:   * `CONFIG_RAM_START`：主 SRAM 起始物理地址，参考目标芯片 datasheet（多数 ARM Cortex-M 为 `0x20000000`）。
L264:   * `CONFIG_RAM_SIZE`：主 SRAM 容量，单位字节。
L265:   * `CONFIG_MM_REGIONS`：堆管理器管理的内存区域数量。当芯片存在多块不连续 SRAM（如 STM32F4 的 CCM、STM32H7 的 AXI/AHB SRAM）时需调整为对应数量。
L266:   * `CONFIG_BOARD_LOOPSPERMSEC`：忙等延时校准值，与 CPU 频率相关，可先填一个估算值，启动后通过 `up_mdelay()` 校准。
L267: ### 3、串口控制台（必须按目标硬件替换）
L268: 
L269:     `CONFIG_STM32_USART2=y
L270:     CONFIG_USART2_SERIAL_CONSOLE=y
L271:     CONFIG_STM32_JTAG_SW_ENABLE=y
L272:     `
L273: 
L274: #### 替换原则
L275: 
L276: 配置项  | 替换原则
L277: --- | ---
L278: `CONFIG_<CHIP>_USART<N>=y`  | 启用目标芯片对应 UART 外设。STM32 用 `STM32_USARTx`，nRF52 用 `NRF52_UART0`，ESP32 用 `ESP32_UART0`
L279: `CONFIG_USART<N>_SERIAL_CONSOLE=y`  | 指定该 UART 作为系统控制台
L280: `CONFIG_<CHIP>_JTAG_SW_ENABLE=y`  | 视目标芯片可选，用于保留 SWD 调试口
L281: 
L282: 参赛者可参考 `nuttx/boards/<arch>/<chip>/<board>/include/board.h` 中的引脚定义，确认串口对应的物理 TX/RX 引脚与电路板设计一致。
L283: ### 4、NSH Shell 启动入口（直接复用）
L284: 
L285:     `CONFIG_SYSTEM_NSH=y
L286:     CONFIG_INIT_ENTRYPOINT="nsh_main"
L287:     `
L288: 
L289: #### 配置项说明
L290: 
L291:   * `CONFIG_SYSTEM_NSH=y`：将 NSH 编译为系统应用。
L292:   * `CONFIG_INIT_ENTRYPOINT="nsh_main"`：将 NSH 设为系统启动后的首个用户态任务，串口接通后即进入命令行提示符。
L293: 
L294: ### 5、调度与运行时支持（直接复用）
L295: 
L296:     `CONFIG_RR_INTERVAL=200
L297:     CONFIG_SCHED_WAITPID=y
L298:     CONFIG_PREALLOC_TIMERS=4
L299:     CONFIG_IDLETHREAD_STACKSIZE=2048
L300:     CONFIG_TASK_NAME_SIZE=0
L301:     CONFIG_START_DAY=27
L302:     CONFIG_START_YEAR=2013
L303:     `
L304: #### 配置项说明
L305: 
L306:   * `CONFIG_RR_INTERVAL=200`：轮转调度时间片为 200 ms。
L307:   * `CONFIG_SCHED_WAITPID=y`：启用 `waitpid()` 系统调用，NSH 在执行内置命令时依赖此特性。
L308:   * `CONFIG_PREALLOC_TIMERS=4`：预分配 4 个 POSIX 定时器，满足基础需求。
L309:   * `CONFIG_IDLETHREAD_STACKSIZE=2048`：idle 线程栈大小，2 KB 适用于多数 Cortex-M 板。RAM 紧张时可下调至 1024。
L310:   * `CONFIG_TASK_NAME_SIZE=0`：禁用任务名称字符串以节省 RAM。如需 `ps` 命令显示任务名，可设为 16~32。
L311:   * `CONFIG_START_DAY` 与 `CONFIG_START_YEAR`：系统启动时的初始日期，可任意填写。
L312: ### 6、调试与诊断（强烈建议保留）
L313: 
L314:     `CONFIG_DEBUG_SYMBOLS=y
L315:     CONFIG_ARCH_STACKDUMP=y
L316:     CONFIG_INTELHEX_BINARY=y
L317:     CONFIG_RAW_BINARY=y
L318:     `
L319: 
L320: #### 配置项说明
L321: 
L322:   * `CONFIG_DEBUG_SYMBOLS=y`：保留调试符号，便于使用 GDB 单步调试与 backtrace 分析。
L323:   * `CONFIG_ARCH_STACKDUMP=y`：系统出现 hardfault 时输出栈内容，移植阶段是定位问题的重要手段。
L324:   * `CONFIG_INTELHEX_BINARY=y` 与 `CONFIG_RAW_BINARY=y`：编译后同时产出 `.hex` 与 `.bin` 两种烧录格式。
L325: 
L326: ### 7、CPU 特性裁剪（按需调整）
L327: 
L328:     `# CONFIG_ARCH_FPU is not set
L329:     `
L330: #### 说明
L331: 
L332: `CONFIG_ARCH_FPU` 控制硬件浮点单元的启用。Cortex-M4F、M7 等带 FPU 的内核如需使用浮点运算，应改为 `CONFIG_ARCH_FPU=y`。Cortex-M0/M3 无 FPU，保持注释状态即可。
L333: 
L334: ### 8、板级辅助（可选）
L335: 
L336:     `CONFIG_ARCH_BUTTONS=y
L337:     `
L338: 
L339: #### 说明
L340: 
L341: `CONFIG_ARCH_BUTTONS=y`：当板上存在 USER 按钮时启用按钮驱动框架。如目标板无按键，可省略。
L342: ## 三、可直接复用的 defconfig 片段
L343: 
L344: 下列 16 项配置与硬件无关，可在任何 ARM Cortex-M 板上原样使用：
L345: 
L346:     `CONFIG_RR_INTERVAL=200
L347:     CONFIG_SCHED_WAITPID=y
L348:     CONFIG_PREALLOC_TIMERS=4
L349:     CONFIG_IDLETHREAD_STACKSIZE=2048
L350:     CONFIG_TASK_NAME_SIZE=0
L351:     CONFIG_START_DAY=27
L352:     CONFIG_START_YEAR=2013
L353:     CONFIG_SYSTEM_NSH=y
L354:     CONFIG_INIT_ENTRYPOINT="nsh_main"
L355:     CONFIG_DEBUG_SYMBOLS=y
L356:     CONFIG_ARCH_STACKDUMP=y
L357:     CONFIG_INTELHEX_BINARY=y
L358:     CONFIG_RAW_BINARY=y
L359:     `

L413: ## 七、新硬件适配 Checklist
L414: 
L415: 参赛者完成 BSP 移植后，建议按以下清单检查 defconfig 完整性与目标硬件兼容性：
L416:   * [Input] `CONFIG_ARCH`、`CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP`、`CONFIG_ARCH_BOARD` 三项已替换为目标硬件标识
L417:   * [Input] `CONFIG_RAM_START` 与 `CONFIG_RAM_SIZE` 已按目标芯片 datasheet 填写
L418:   * [Input] 多 SRAM 区芯片（如 STM32F4 含 CCM）已正确设置 `CONFIG_MM_REGIONS`
L419:   * [Input] 串口外设宏（如 `CONFIG_STM32_USART2=y`）已切换至目标芯片对应 UART
L420:   * [Input] `CONFIG_USART<N>_SERIAL_CONSOLE=y` 与 `board.h` 中的引脚定义一致
L421:   * [Input] 串口波特率默认为 115200，与上位机终端一致
L422:   * [Input] `CONFIG_SYSTEM_NSH=y` 与 `CONFIG_INIT_ENTRYPOINT="nsh_main"` 已启用
L423:   * [Input] `CONFIG_DEBUG_SYMBOLS=y` 与 `CONFIG_ARCH_STACKDUMP=y` 已启用，便于排查启动问题
L424:   * [Input] 带 FPU 的内核（M4F/M7）已启用 `CONFIG_ARCH_FPU=y`，无 FPU 的内核（M0/M3）保持关闭
L425:   * [Input] `CONFIG_BOARD_LOOPSPERMSEC` 已根据 CPU 频率设置初始估算值
L426: 通过 Checklist 后即可执行 `./build.sh <vendor>:<config> -j` 编译。烧录后，串口接通并出现 `nsh> ` 提示符即代表 L0 启动成功。

**实板验证**

1. 连接端口：
   - 烧录口：`/dev/ttyACM0`
   - UART0 控制台：`/dev/ttyUSB0`
   - 波特率：115200
   - UART 引脚：GPIO37 TX、GPIO38 RX

2. 先打开控制台：

```bash
picocom -b 115200 /dev/ttyUSB0
```

3. 另开终端烧录：

```bash
cd ~/openvela-work/contest284/nuttx
source ~/venvs/esp-tools/bin/activate

make flash \
  ESPTOOL_PORT=/dev/ttyACM0 \
  ESPTOOL_BINDIR=./
```

若无法进入下载模式，按住 `BOOT`，点按 `RESET`，再释放 `BOOT`。

4. 看到 `nsh>` 后依次运行：

```text
help
uname -a
ps
free
uptime
sleep 1
uptime
```

5. 通过条件：
   - UART 收发正常。
   - `help`、`uname`、`ps`、`free` 返回正常。
   - 两次 `uptime` 持续增长，验证 SYSTIMER/IRQ/tick。
   - `sleep 1` 能返回提示符。

   518	  /* Setting up an IRQ includes the following steps:

Author: Tiago Medicci Serrano <tiago.medicci@espressif.com>

    arch/risc-v/src/common: Create SoC-specific initialization routine
    
    This commits adds a function that can be implemented by any vendor
    to allow SoC-specific functions to be called by `up_initialize`.
    Please note that `up_initialize` is provided by the arch level, but
    it doesn't allow SoC-specific initialization. Although it could be
    possible to run such initialization on board-level, semantically
    it isn't related to the board, but with the SoC. As an example of
    such implementation, some SoCs require RTC subsystem initialization
    to occur before the OS is completely initialized.
    
    Signed-off-by: Tiago Medicci Serrano <tiago.medicci@espressif.com>

diff --git a/arch/risc-v/src/common/riscv_initialize.c b/arch/risc-v/src/common/riscv_initialize.c
index 355fa47bdec..b3dcf4ad7ff 100644
--- a/arch/risc-v/src/common/riscv_initialize.c
+++ b/arch/risc-v/src/common/riscv_initialize.c
@@ -98,5 +98,12 @@ void up_initialize(void)
 
   riscv_netinitialize();
 
+#ifdef CONFIG_HAVE_WEAKFUNCTIONS
+  if (riscv_soc_initialize)
+#endif
+    {
+      riscv_soc_initialize();
+    }
+
   board_autoled_on(LED_IRQSENABLED);
 }
diff --git a/arch/risc-v/src/common/riscv_internal.h b/arch/risc-v/src/common/riscv_internal.h
index ef10f57e61a..d8a1e969afd 100644
--- a/arch/risc-v/src/common/riscv_internal.h

 void weak_function riscv_dma_initialize(void);
 #endif
 
+/* SoC-specific CPU initialization ******************************************/
+
+void weak_function riscv_soc_initialize(void);
+

 void riscv_lowputc(char ch);

L199: # 最小可运行 NSH 系统 defconfig 参考
L200: 
L201: [ cite77†English | 简体中文 ]
L202: 
L203: 本文档面向「新硬件适配赛道」的开发者，目标是帮助开发者在自己的开发板上先启动到 NSH 命令行提示符。建议的工作流是：先以本文给出的最小集启动，验证串口与 NSH 工作正常后，再按需逐步打开文件系统、网络、传感器等子系统。
L204: 
L205: ## 一、概述
L206: ### 1、文档目标
L207: 
L208: 参赛者拿到一块尚未适配 openvela 的开发板后，最关键的第一步是让系统能启动到 NSH 命令行提示符。本文档提供一份最小的 defconfig 参考，仅包含启动 NSH 所必需的配置项，便于参赛者：
L209: 
L210:   * 快速判断哪些 CONFIG 必须修改（与目标硬件强相关）；
L211:   * 哪些 CONFIG 可直接复用（与硬件无关的运行时支持）；
L212:   * 完成 L0 启动后，按子系统顺序增量启用功能。
L213: ### 2、推荐工作流
L214: 
L215:     `Step 0: 硬件就绪
L216:             - 目标芯片在 nuttx/arch/<arch>/src/<chip>/ 下已有支持
L217:             - 板级目录已建立 (boards/<arch>/<chip>/<board>/)
L218:             - 串口 TX/RX 引脚与上位机连通
L219:             ↓
L220:     Step 1: 套用本文最小集 → 编译 → 烧录 → 串口看到 NSH 提示符
L221:             ↓
L222:     Step 2: 按硬件能力增量启用子系统
L223:             - 文件系统 (FAT / LittleFS)
L224:             - 网络协议栈 (Ethernet / Wi-Fi)
L225:             - 图形 (LCD / framebuffer / LVGL)
L226:             - 传感 (uORB / I2C / SPI sensors)
L227:             ↓
L228:     Step 3: 移植稳定后做 release 瘦身
L229:             - 关闭 DEBUG_*、ALLSYMS 等调试项
L230:             - 调整 stack size 至实测需求
L231:     `
L232: ## 二、最小 NSH 必需配置
L233: 
L234: 本节配置项参考 `nuttx/boards/arm/stm32/nucleo-f303re/configs/nsh/defconfig`（35 行）整理而来，并参考了 Mateusz Szafoni 的 cite78†NuttX small systems 系列文章†www.railab.me 对最小化裁剪的实践经验。
L235: 
L236: ### 1、架构与板级标识（必须按目标硬件替换）
L237: 
L238:     `CONFIG_ARCH="arm"
L239:     CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP="stm32"
L240:     CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_STM32=y
L241:     CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_STM32F303RE=y
L242:     CONFIG_ARCH_BOARD="nucleo-f303re"
L243:     CONFIG_ARCH_BOARD_NUCLEO_F303RE=y
L244:     `
L245: #### 替换原则
L246: 
L247: 配置项  | 替换原则
L248: --- | ---
L249: `CONFIG_ARCH=`  | 目标 CPU 架构，例如 `"arm"`、`"arm64"`、`"risc-v"`、`"xtensa"`
L250: `CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP=` 与 `CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_<FAMILY>=y`  | 目标 SoC 家族，需与 `nuttx/arch/<arch>/src/<chip>/` 目录一致（如 `stm32`、`stm32h7`、`nrf52`、`esp32s3`）
L251: `CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_<DEVICE>=y`  | 具体型号，例如 `STM32F407VG`、`NRF52840`、`ESP32S3`
L252: `CONFIG_ARCH_BOARD=` 与 `CONFIG_ARCH_BOARD_<NAME>=y`  | 板级目录名，需与 `nuttx/boards/<arch>/<chip>/<board>/` 一致
L253: ### 2、内存布局（必须按目标硬件填写）
L254: 
L255:     `CONFIG_RAM_START=0x20000000
L256:     CONFIG_RAM_SIZE=65536
L257:     CONFIG_MM_REGIONS=2
L258:     CONFIG_BOARD_LOOPSPERMSEC=6522
L259:     `
L260: 
L261: #### 配置项说明
L262: 
L263:   * `CONFIG_RAM_START`：主 SRAM 起始物理地址，参考目标芯片 datasheet（多数 ARM Cortex-M 为 `0x20000000`）。
L264:   * `CONFIG_RAM_SIZE`：主 SRAM 容量，单位字节。
L265:   * `CONFIG_MM_REGIONS`：堆管理器管理的内存区域数量。当芯片存在多块不连续 SRAM（如 STM32F4 的 CCM、STM32H7 的 AXI/AHB SRAM）时需调整为对应数量。
L266:   * `CONFIG_BOARD_LOOPSPERMSEC`：忙等延时校准值，与 CPU 频率相关，可先填一个估算值，启动后通过 `up_mdelay()` 校准。
L267: ### 3、串口控制台（必须按目标硬件替换）
L268: 
L269:     `CONFIG_STM32_USART2=y
L270:     CONFIG_USART2_SERIAL_CONSOLE=y
L271:     CONFIG_STM32_JTAG_SW_ENABLE=y
L272:     `
L273: 
L274: #### 替换原则
L275: 
L276: 配置项  | 替换原则
L277: --- | ---
L278: `CONFIG_<CHIP>_USART<N>=y`  | 启用目标芯片对应 UART 外设。STM32 用 `STM32_USARTx`，nRF52 用 `NRF52_UART0`，ESP32 用 `ESP32_UART0`
L279: `CONFIG_USART<N>_SERIAL_CONSOLE=y`  | 指定该 UART 作为系统控制台
L280: `CONFIG_<CHIP>_JTAG_SW_ENABLE=y`  | 视目标芯片可选，用于保留 SWD 调试口
L281: 
L282: 参赛者可参考 `nuttx/boards/<arch>/<chip>/<board>/include/board.h` 中的引脚定义，确认串口对应的物理 TX/RX 引脚与电路板设计一致。
L283: ### 4、NSH Shell 启动入口（直接复用）
L284: 
L285:     `CONFIG_SYSTEM_NSH=y
L286:     CONFIG_INIT_ENTRYPOINT="nsh_main"
L287:     `
L288: 
L289: #### 配置项说明
L290: 
L291:   * `CONFIG_SYSTEM_NSH=y`：将 NSH 编译为系统应用。
L292:   * `CONFIG_INIT_ENTRYPOINT="nsh_main"`：将 NSH 设为系统启动后的首个用户态任务，串口接通后即进入命令行提示符。
L293: 
L294: ### 5、调度与运行时支持（直接复用）
L295: 
L296:     `CONFIG_RR_INTERVAL=200
L297:     CONFIG_SCHED_WAITPID=y
L298:     CONFIG_PREALLOC_TIMERS=4
L299:     CONFIG_IDLETHREAD_STACKSIZE=2048
L300:     CONFIG_TASK_NAME_SIZE=0
L301:     CONFIG_START_DAY=27
L302:     CONFIG_START_YEAR=2013
L303:     `
L304: #### 配置项说明
L305: 
L306:   * `CONFIG_RR_INTERVAL=200`：轮转调度时间片为 200 ms。
L307:   * `CONFIG_SCHED_WAITPID=y`：启用 `waitpid()` 系统调用，NSH 在执行内置命令时依赖此特性。
L308:   * `CONFIG_PREALLOC_TIMERS=4`：预分配 4 个 POSIX 定时器，满足基础需求。
L309:   * `CONFIG_IDLETHREAD_STACKSIZE=2048`：idle 线程栈大小，2 KB 适用于多数 Cortex-M 板。RAM 紧张时可下调至 1024。
L310:   * `CONFIG_TASK_NAME_SIZE=0`：禁用任务名称字符串以节省 RAM。如需 `ps` 命令显示任务名，可设为 16~32。
L311:   * `CONFIG_START_DAY` 与 `CONFIG_START_YEAR`：系统启动时的初始日期，可任意填写。
L312: ### 6、调试与诊断（强烈建议保留）
L313: 
L314:     `CONFIG_DEBUG_SYMBOLS=y
L315:     CONFIG_ARCH_STACKDUMP=y
L316:     CONFIG_INTELHEX_BINARY=y
L317:     CONFIG_RAW_BINARY=y
L318:     `
L319: 
L320: #### 配置项说明
L321: 
L322:   * `CONFIG_DEBUG_SYMBOLS=y`：保留调试符号，便于使用 GDB 单步调试与 backtrace 分析。
L323:   * `CONFIG_ARCH_STACKDUMP=y`：系统出现 hardfault 时输出栈内容，移植阶段是定位问题的重要手段。
L324:   * `CONFIG_INTELHEX_BINARY=y` 与 `CONFIG_RAW_BINARY=y`：编译后同时产出 `.hex` 与 `.bin` 两种烧录格式。
L325: 
L326: ### 7、CPU 特性裁剪（按需调整）
L327: 
L328:     `# CONFIG_ARCH_FPU is not set
L329:     `
L330: #### 说明
L331: 
L332: `CONFIG_ARCH_FPU` 控制硬件浮点单元的启用。Cortex-M4F、M7 等带 FPU 的内核如需使用浮点运算，应改为 `CONFIG_ARCH_FPU=y`。Cortex-M0/M3 无 FPU，保持注释状态即可。
L333: 
L334: ### 8、板级辅助（可选）
L335: 
L336:     `CONFIG_ARCH_BUTTONS=y
L337:     `
L338: 
L339: #### 说明
L340: 
L341: `CONFIG_ARCH_BUTTONS=y`：当板上存在 USER 按钮时启用按钮驱动框架。如目标板无按键，可省略。
L342: ## 三、可直接复用的 defconfig 片段
L343: 
L344: 下列 16 项配置与硬件无关，可在任何 ARM Cortex-M 板上原样使用：
L345: 
L346:     `CONFIG_RR_INTERVAL=200
L347:     CONFIG_SCHED_WAITPID=y
L348:     CONFIG_PREALLOC_TIMERS=4
L349:     CONFIG_IDLETHREAD_STACKSIZE=2048
L350:     CONFIG_TASK_NAME_SIZE=0
L351:     CONFIG_START_DAY=27
L352:     CONFIG_START_YEAR=2013
L353:     CONFIG_SYSTEM_NSH=y
L354:     CONFIG_INIT_ENTRYPOINT="nsh_main"
L355:     CONFIG_DEBUG_SYMBOLS=y
L356:     CONFIG_ARCH_STACKDUMP=y
L357:     CONFIG_INTELHEX_BINARY=y
L358:     CONFIG_RAW_BINARY=y
L359:     `
L360: 参赛者只需根据自己的硬件填写第二节中标注「必须按目标硬件替换」的部分（架构标识、内存布局、串口配置），即可形成完整的 L0 defconfig。
L361: ## 四、参考实现
L362: 
L363: ### 1、Nucleo-F303RE（参考板）
L364: 
L365: 完整 defconfig 路径：
L366: 
L367:     `nuttx/boards/arm/stm32/nucleo-f303re/configs/nsh/defconfig
L368:     `
L369: 
L370: 该板搭载 STM32F303RE（Cortex-M4F @ 72 MHz, 512 KB Flash, 64 KB SRAM），板载 ST-Link/V2-1 调试器与 USB 虚拟串口，参赛者只需一根 USB 线即可完成烧录与串口连接，是验证最小 NSH 流程最便捷的硬件参考。
L371: ### 2、其他可参考的最小 NSH defconfig

L379: ## 五、增量启用子系统
L380: 
L381: L0 启动成功（串口看到 NSH 提示符）后，可按目标板的硬件能力逐步启用子系统。各类子系统的常用 CONFIG 起点如下：
L382: 
L383: 子系统  | 主要 CONFIG 起点
L384: --- | ---
L385: 文件系统（FAT、LittleFS、PROCFS）  | `CONFIG_FS_FAT`、`CONFIG_FS_LITTLEFS`、`CONFIG_FS_PROCFS`
L386: 网络协议栈（TCP/IP、Wi-Fi）  | `CONFIG_NET`、`CONFIG_NET_TCP`、`CONFIG_NET_UDP`
L387: 图形与显示（fb、LCD、LVGL）  | `CONFIG_VIDEO_FB`、`CONFIG_GRAPHICS_LVGL`
L388: 传感与 uORB  | `CONFIG_SENSORS`、`CONFIG_UORB`
L389: 蓝牙（BLE）  | `CONFIG_BLUETOOTH`、`CONFIG_NIMBLE`
L390: 音频  | `CONFIG_AUDIO`
L391: 电源管理  | `CONFIG_PM`
L392: 参赛者也可参考 `vendor/openvela/boards/vela/configs/goldfish-x86_64-ap/defconfig`（253 行）了解 openvela 在子系统全开场景下的完整 CONFIG 集合，作为增量启用时的对照样本。
L393: ## 六、功能验证
L394: 
L395: 子系统启用后，建议通过标准化测试用例验证目标硬件上各子系统的功能完整性。openvela 社区维护了一份面向社区开发者的 xTS 测试用例精简集，覆盖了外设驱动、文件系统、网络、媒体等多个子系统，可作为子系统启用后的功能验收手段。
L396: 
L397: ### 1、推荐使用方式
L398: 
L399:   * L0 启动验证：参赛者按本文最小集完成 NSH 启动后，通过串口手动输入命令（如 `help`、`uname`、`ps`）验证基础 shell 与系统调用工作正常。
L400:   * 子系统功能验证：每启用一个子系统后，从 xTS 测试集中选取该子系统对应的用例运行（如启用 SPI/I2C 驱动后跑 SPI_I2C 测试）。
L401:   * 回归验证：移植稳定后，将整套 xTS 用例作为回归测试集，便于后续配置变更后的功能确认。
L402: ### 2、xTS 测试集覆盖范围
L403: 
L404: 测试主题  | 适用场景
L405: --- | ---
L406: SPI / I2C 驱动  | 外设驱动启用后验证总线通信（含 BMI160 传感器示例）
L407: Ymodem 文件传输  | 串口文件传输能力验证
L408: mediatool 媒体测试  | 音视频编解码与播放链路验证
L409: WiFi 兼容性  | 已适配路由器列表与连接稳定性验证
L410: 自测试框架（cmocka）  | 编写自定义单元测试时的框架使用方法
L411: 
L412: 详细的测试步骤、测试资源与依赖配置请参考 cite79†openvela 社区开发者 xTS 测试用例精简集 与 cite80†openvela 自测试框架使用指南 。
L413: ## 七、新硬件适配 Checklist
L414: 
L415: 参赛者完成 BSP 移植后，建议按以下清单检查 defconfig 完整性与目标硬件兼容性：
L416:   * [Input] `CONFIG_ARCH`、`CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP`、`CONFIG_ARCH_BOARD` 三项已替换为目标硬件标识
L417:   * [Input] `CONFIG_RAM_START` 与 `CONFIG_RAM_SIZE` 已按目标芯片 datasheet 填写
L418:   * [Input] 多 SRAM 区芯片（如 STM32F4 含 CCM）已正确设置 `CONFIG_MM_REGIONS`
L419:   * [Input] 串口外设宏（如 `CONFIG_STM32_USART2=y`）已切换至目标芯片对应 UART
L420:   * [Input] `CONFIG_USART<N>_SERIAL_CONSOLE=y` 与 `board.h` 中的引脚定义一致
L421:   * [Input] 串口波特率默认为 115200，与上位机终端一致
L422:   * [Input] `CONFIG_SYSTEM_NSH=y` 与 `CONFIG_INIT_ENTRYPOINT="nsh_main"` 已启用
L423:   * [Input] `CONFIG_DEBUG_SYMBOLS=y` 与 `CONFIG_ARCH_STACKDUMP=y` 已启用，便于排查启动问题
L424:   * [Input] 带 FPU 的内核（M4F/M7）已启用 `CONFIG_ARCH_FPU=y`，无 FPU 的内核（M0/M3）保持关闭
L425:   * [Input] `CONFIG_BOARD_LOOPSPERMSEC` 已根据 CPU 频率设置初始估算值
L426: 通过 Checklist 后即可执行 `./build.sh <vendor>:<config> -j` 编译。烧录后，串口接通并出现 `nsh> ` 提示符即代表 L0 启动成功。

  KCONFIG_OLDCONFIG     = kconfig-conf --oldconfig Kconfig

  KCONFIG_QCONFIG       = kconfig-qconf Kconfig
  KCONFIG_GCONFIG       = kconfig-gconf Kconfig

# Configure the variables according to build environment

ESPTOOL_MIN_VERSION := 4.8.0

ifdef ESPTOOL_BINDIR
	ifeq ($(CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_BOOTLOADER_MCUBOOT),y)
		ifeq ($(CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_ESP32P4),y)
			BL_OFFSET := 0x2000
		else
			BL_OFFSET := 0x0000
		endif
		BOOTLOADER      := $(ESPTOOL_BINDIR)/mcuboot-$(CHIP_SERIES).bin
		FLASH_BL        := $(BL_OFFSET) $(BOOTLOADER)
		ESPTOOL_BINS    := $(FLASH_BL)
	endif
endif

ifeq ($(CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_BOOTLOADER_MCUBOOT),y)
	ifeq ($(CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_ESPTOOL_TARGET_PRIMARY),y)
		VERIFIED   := --confirm
		APP_OFFSET := $(CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_OTA_PRIMARY_SLOT_OFFSET)
	else ifeq ($(CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_ESPTOOL_TARGET_SECONDARY),y)
		VERIFIED   :=
		APP_OFFSET := $(CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_OTA_SECONDARY_SLOT_OFFSET)
	endif

	APP_IMAGE      := nuttx.bin
	FLASH_APP      := $(APP_OFFSET) $(APP_IMAGE)
	IMGTOOL_ALIGN_ARGS := --align 4
	IMGTOOL_SIGN_ARGS  := --pad $(VERIFIED) $(IMGTOOL_ALIGN_ARGS) -v $(CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_MCUBOOT_SIGN_IMAGE_VERSION) -s auto \
		-H $(CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_APP_MCUBOOT_HEADER_SIZE) --pad-header \
		-S $(CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_OTA_SLOT_SIZE)
else ifeq ($(CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_SIMPLE_BOOT),y)
	ifeq ($(CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_ESP32P4),y)
		APP_OFFSET := 0x2000
	else
		APP_OFFSET := 0x0000
	endif
	APP_IMAGE      := nuttx.bin
	FLASH_APP      := $(APP_OFFSET) $(APP_IMAGE)
	ESPTOOL_BINDIR := .
endif

ESPTOOL_BINS += $(FLASH_APP)

# MERGEBIN -- Merge raw binary files into a single file

define MERGEBIN
	@python3 tools/espressif/check_esptool.py -v $(ESPTOOL_MIN_VERSION)
	$(Q) if [ -z $(ESPTOOL_BINDIR) ]; then \
		echo "MERGEBIN error: Missing argument for binary files directory."; \
		echo "USAGE: make ESPTOOL_BINDIR=<dir>"; \
		exit 1; \
	fi
	$(Q) if [ -z $(FLASH_SIZE) ]; then \
		echo "Missing Flash memory size configuration."; \
		exit 1; \
	fi
	esptool.py -c $(CHIP_SERIES) merge_bin --output nuttx.merged.bin $(ESPTOOL_BINS)
	$(Q) echo nuttx.merged.bin >> nuttx.manifest
	$(Q) echo "Generated: nuttx.merged.bin"
endef

endif

# POSTBUILD -- Perform post build operations

define POSTBUILD
	$(call MKIMAGE)
	$(if $(CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_MERGE_BINS),$(call MERGEBIN))
endef

# ESPTOOL_BAUD -- Serial port baud rate used when flashing/reading via esptool.py

ESPTOOL_BAUD ?= 921600

# FLASH -- Download a binary image via esptool.py

define FLASH
	$(Q) if [ -z $(ESPTOOL_PORT) ]; then \
		echo "FLASH error: Missing serial port device argument."; \
		echo "USAGE: make flash ESPTOOL_PORT=<port> [ ESPTOOL_BAUD=<baud> ]"; \
		exit 1; \
	fi

	$(eval ESPTOOL_OPTS := -c $(CHIP_SERIES) -p $(ESPTOOL_PORT) -b $(ESPTOOL_BAUD) $(if $(CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_ESPTOOLPY_NO_STUB),--no-stub))
	$(eval WRITEFLASH_OPTS := $(if $(CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_MERGE_BINS),0x0 nuttx.merged.bin,$(ESPTOOL_WRITEFLASH_OPTS) $(ESPTOOL_BINS)))
	esptool.py $(ESPTOOL_OPTS) write_flash $(WRITEFLASH_OPTS)
endef

+{
+  int uart_num = priv->id;
+  bool newly_enabled = false;
+  mutex_t lock;
+
+  nxmutex_init(&lock);
+
+  g_uart_context[uart_num].mutex = (_lock_t)&lock;
+
+  _lock_acquire(&(g_uart_context[uart_num].mutex));
+
+  if (g_uart_context[uart_num].hw_enabled != true)
+    {
+      if (uart_num < SOC_UART_HP_NUM)
+        {
+          PERIPH_RCC_ATOMIC()
+            {
+              uart_ll_enable_bus_clock(uart_num, true);
+            }
+
+          if (uart_num != CONFIG_ESP_CONSOLE_UART_NUM)
+            {
+              PERIPH_RCC_ATOMIC()
+                {
+                  uart_ll_reset_register(uart_num);
+                }
+
+              PERIPH_RCC_ATOMIC()
+                {
+                  uart_ll_sclk_enable(g_uart_context[uart_num].hal.dev);
+                }
+            }
+        }
+
+      g_uart_context[uart_num].hw_enabled = true;
+      newly_enabled = true;
+    }
+
+  _lock_release(&(g_uart_context[uart_num].mutex));
+  nxmutex_destroy(&lock);
+  g_uart_context[uart_num].mutex = NULL;
+  return newly_enabled;

501:void nx_bringup(void)
 *
 * Description:
 *   This is the framework for a short duration worker thread.  It off-loads
 *   the board initialization and application start-up from the limited
 *   start-up, initialization thread to a more robust kernel thread.
 *
 * Input Parameters:
 *   None
 *
 * Returned Value:
 *   None
 *
 ****************************************************************************/

#ifdef CONFIG_BOARD_LATE_INITIALIZE
static int nx_start_task(int argc, FAR char **argv)
{
  /* Do the board/application initialization and exit */

  nx_start_application();
  return OK;
}
#endif

/****************************************************************************
 * Name: nx_create_initthread
 *
 * Description:
 *   Execute the board initialization function (if so configured) and start
 *   the application initialization thread.  This will be done either on the
 *   thread of execution of the caller or on a separate thread of execution
 *   if so configured.
 *
 * Input Parameters:
 *   None
 *
 * Returned Value:
 *   None
 *
 ****************************************************************************/

static inline void nx_create_initthread(void)
{
#ifdef CONFIG_BOARD_LATE_INITIALIZE
  int pid;

  /* Do the board/application initialization on a separate thread of
   * execution.
   */

  pid = nxthread_create("AppBringUp", TCB_FLAG_TTYPE_KERNEL,
                        CONFIG_BOARD_INITTHREAD_PRIORITY,
                        NULL, CONFIG_BOARD_INITTHREAD_STACKSIZE,
                        nx_start_task, NULL, environ);
  DEBUGASSERT(pid > 0);
  UNUSED(pid);
#else
  /* Do the board/application initialization on this thread of execution. */

  nx_start_application();
#endif
}

/****************************************************************************
 * Public Functions
 ****************************************************************************/

/****************************************************************************
 * Name: nx_bringup
 *
 * Description:
 *   Start all initial system tasks.  This does the "system bring-up" after
 *   the conclusion of basic OS initialization.  These initial system tasks
 *   may include:
 *
 *   - pg_worker:   The page-fault worker thread (if CONFIG_LEGACY_PAGING is
 *                  defined).
 *   - work_thread: The work thread.  This general thread can be used to
 *                  perform most any kind of queued work.  Its primary
 *                  function is to serve as the "bottom half" of device
 *                  drivers.
 *
 *   And the main application entry point:
 *   symbols, either:
 *
 *   - CONFIG_INIT_ENTRYPOINT: This is the default user application entry
 *                 point, or
 *   - CONFIG_INIT_FILEPATH: The full path to the location in a mounted
 *                 file system where we can expect to find the
 *                 initialization program.  Presumably, this file system
 *                 was mounted by board-specific logic when
 *                 board_late_initialize() was called.
 *
 * Input Parameters:
 *   None
 *
 * Returned Value:
 *   None
 *
 ****************************************************************************/

void nx_bringup(void)
{
  sched_trace_begin();

#ifndef CONFIG_DISABLE_ENVIRON
  /* Setup up the initial environment for the idle task.  At present, this
   * may consist of only the initial PATH variable and/or and init library
   * path variable.  These path variables are not used by the IDLE task.
   * However, the environment containing the PATH variable will be inherited
   * by all of the threads created by the IDLE task.
   */

#ifdef CONFIG_LIBC_HOMEDIR
  setenv("PWD", CONFIG_LIBC_HOMEDIR, 1);
#endif

#ifdef CONFIG_PATH_INITIAL
  setenv("PATH", CONFIG_PATH_INITIAL, 1);
#endif

#ifdef CONFIG_LDPATH_INITIAL
  setenv("LD_LIBRARY_PATH", CONFIG_LDPATH_INITIAL, 1);
#endif
#endif

  /* Start the page fill worker kernel thread that will resolve page faults.
   * This should always be the first thread started because it may have to
   * resolve page faults in other threads
   */

  nx_pgworker();

  /* Start the worker thread that will serve as the device driver "bottom-
   * half" and will perform misc garbage clean-up.
   */

  nx_workqueues();

  /* Once the operating system has been initialized, the system must be
   * started by spawning the user initialization thread of execution.  This
   * will be the first user-mode thread.
   */

  nx_create_initthread();

#if !defined(CONFIG_DISABLE_ENVIRON) && (defined(CONFIG_PATH_INITIAL) || \
     defined(CONFIG_LDPATH_INITIAL))
  /* We would save a few bytes by discarding the IDLE thread's environment.
   * But when kthreads share the same group, this is no longer proper, so
   * we can't do clearenv() now.
   */

#endif

  sched_trace_end();
}

L199: # 最小可运行 NSH 系统 defconfig 参考
L200: 
L201: [ cite77†English | 简体中文 ]
L202: 
L203: 本文档面向「新硬件适配赛道」的开发者，目标是帮助开发者在自己的开发板上先启动到 NSH 命令行提示符。建议的工作流是：先以本文给出的最小集启动，验证串口与 NSH 工作正常后，再按需逐步打开文件系统、网络、传感器等子系统。
L204: 
L205: ## 一、概述
L206: ### 1、文档目标
L207: 
L208: 参赛者拿到一块尚未适配 openvela 的开发板后，最关键的第一步是让系统能启动到 NSH 命令行提示符。本文档提供一份最小的 defconfig 参考，仅包含启动 NSH 所必需的配置项，便于参赛者：
L209: 
L210:   * 快速判断哪些 CONFIG 必须修改（与目标硬件强相关）；
L211:   * 哪些 CONFIG 可直接复用（与硬件无关的运行时支持）；
L212:   * 完成 L0 启动后，按子系统顺序增量启用功能。
L213: ### 2、推荐工作流
L214: 
L215:     `Step 0: 硬件就绪
L216:             - 目标芯片在 nuttx/arch/<arch>/src/<chip>/ 下已有支持
L217:             - 板级目录已建立 (boards/<arch>/<chip>/<board>/)
L218:             - 串口 TX/RX 引脚与上位机连通
L219:             ↓
L220:     Step 1: 套用本文最小集 → 编译 → 烧录 → 串口看到 NSH 提示符
L221:             ↓
L222:     Step 2: 按硬件能力增量启用子系统
L223:             - 文件系统 (FAT / LittleFS)
L224:             - 网络协议栈 (Ethernet / Wi-Fi)
L225:             - 图形 (LCD / framebuffer / LVGL)
L226:             - 传感 (uORB / I2C / SPI sensors)
L227:             ↓
L228:     Step 3: 移植稳定后做 release 瘦身
L229:             - 关闭 DEBUG_*、ALLSYMS 等调试项
L230:             - 调整 stack size 至实测需求
L231:     `
L232: ## 二、最小 NSH 必需配置
L233: 
L234: 本节配置项参考 `nuttx/boards/arm/stm32/nucleo-f303re/configs/nsh/defconfig`（35 行）整理而来，并参考了 Mateusz Szafoni 的 cite78†NuttX small systems 系列文章†www.railab.me 对最小化裁剪的实践经验。
L235: 
L236: ### 1、架构与板级标识（必须按目标硬件替换）
L237: 
L238:     `CONFIG_ARCH="arm"
L239:     CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP="stm32"
L240:     CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_STM32=y
L241:     CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_STM32F303RE=y
L242:     CONFIG_ARCH_BOARD="nucleo-f303re"
L243:     CONFIG_ARCH_BOARD_NUCLEO_F303RE=y
L244:     `
L245: #### 替换原则
L246: 
L247: 配置项  | 替换原则
L248: --- | ---
L249: `CONFIG_ARCH=`  | 目标 CPU 架构，例如 `"arm"`、`"arm64"`、`"risc-v"`、`"xtensa"`
L250: `CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP=` 与 `CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_<FAMILY>=y`  | 目标 SoC 家族，需与 `nuttx/arch/<arch>/src/<chip>/` 目录一致（如 `stm32`、`stm32h7`、`nrf52`、`esp32s3`）
L251: `CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_<DEVICE>=y`  | 具体型号，例如 `STM32F407VG`、`NRF52840`、`ESP32S3`
L252: `CONFIG_ARCH_BOARD=` 与 `CONFIG_ARCH_BOARD_<NAME>=y`  | 板级目录名，需与 `nuttx/boards/<arch>/<chip>/<board>/` 一致
L253: ### 2、内存布局（必须按目标硬件填写）
L254: 
L255:     `CONFIG_RAM_START=0x20000000
L256:     CONFIG_RAM_SIZE=65536
L257:     CONFIG_MM_REGIONS=2
L258:     CONFIG_BOARD_LOOPSPERMSEC=6522
L259:     `
L260: 
L261: #### 配置项说明
L262: 
L263:   * `CONFIG_RAM_START`：主 SRAM 起始物理地址，参考目标芯片 datasheet（多数 ARM Cortex-M 为 `0x20000000`）。
L264:   * `CONFIG_RAM_SIZE`：主 SRAM 容量，单位字节。
L265:   * `CONFIG_MM_REGIONS`：堆管理器管理的内存区域数量。当芯片存在多块不连续 SRAM（如 STM32F4 的 CCM、STM32H7 的 AXI/AHB SRAM）时需调整为对应数量。
L266:   * `CONFIG_BOARD_LOOPSPERMSEC`：忙等延时校准值，与 CPU 频率相关，可先填一个估算值，启动后通过 `up_mdelay()` 校准。
L267: ### 3、串口控制台（必须按目标硬件替换）
L268: 
L269:     `CONFIG_STM32_USART2=y
L270:     CONFIG_USART2_SERIAL_CONSOLE=y
L271:     CONFIG_STM32_JTAG_SW_ENABLE=y
L272:     `
L273: 
L274: #### 替换原则
L275: 
L276: 配置项  | 替换原则
L277: --- | ---
L278: `CONFIG_<CHIP>_USART<N>=y`  | 启用目标芯片对应 UART 外设。STM32 用 `STM32_USARTx`，nRF52 用 `NRF52_UART0`，ESP32 用 `ESP32_UART0`
L279: `CONFIG_USART<N>_SERIAL_CONSOLE=y`  | 指定该 UART 作为系统控制台
L280: `CONFIG_<CHIP>_JTAG_SW_ENABLE=y`  | 视目标芯片可选，用于保留 SWD 调试口
L281: 
L282: 参赛者可参考 `nuttx/boards/<arch>/<chip>/<board>/include/board.h` 中的引脚定义，确认串口对应的物理 TX/RX 引脚与电路板设计一致。
L283: ### 4、NSH Shell 启动入口（直接复用）
L284: 
L285:     `CONFIG_SYSTEM_NSH=y
L286:     CONFIG_INIT_ENTRYPOINT="nsh_main"
L287:     `
L288: 
L289: #### 配置项说明
L290: 
L291:   * `CONFIG_SYSTEM_NSH=y`：将 NSH 编译为系统应用。
L292:   * `CONFIG_INIT_ENTRYPOINT="nsh_main"`：将 NSH 设为系统启动后的首个用户态任务，串口接通后即进入命令行提示符。
L293: 
L294: ### 5、调度与运行时支持（直接复用）
L295: 
L296:     `CONFIG_RR_INTERVAL=200
L297:     CONFIG_SCHED_WAITPID=y
L298:     CONFIG_PREALLOC_TIMERS=4
L299:     CONFIG_IDLETHREAD_STACKSIZE=2048
L300:     CONFIG_TASK_NAME_SIZE=0
L301:     CONFIG_START_DAY=27
L302:     CONFIG_START_YEAR=2013
L303:     `
L304: #### 配置项说明
L305: 
L306:   * `CONFIG_RR_INTERVAL=200`：轮转调度时间片为 200 ms。
L307:   * `CONFIG_SCHED_WAITPID=y`：启用 `waitpid()` 系统调用，NSH 在执行内置命令时依赖此特性。
L308:   * `CONFIG_PREALLOC_TIMERS=4`：预分配 4 个 POSIX 定时器，满足基础需求。
L309:   * `CONFIG_IDLETHREAD_STACKSIZE=2048`：idle 线程栈大小，2 KB 适用于多数 Cortex-M 板。RAM 紧张时可下调至 1024。
L310:   * `CONFIG_TASK_NAME_SIZE=0`：禁用任务名称字符串以节省 RAM。如需 `ps` 命令显示任务名，可设为 16~32。
L311:   * `CONFIG_START_DAY` 与 `CONFIG_START_YEAR`：系统启动时的初始日期，可任意填写。
L312: ### 6、调试与诊断（强烈建议保留）
L313: 
L314:     `CONFIG_DEBUG_SYMBOLS=y
L315:     CONFIG_ARCH_STACKDUMP=y
L316:     CONFIG_INTELHEX_BINARY=y
L317:     CONFIG_RAW_BINARY=y
L318:     `
L319: 
L320: #### 配置项说明
L321: 
L322:   * `CONFIG_DEBUG_SYMBOLS=y`：保留调试符号，便于使用 GDB 单步调试与 backtrace 分析。
L323:   * `CONFIG_ARCH_STACKDUMP=y`：系统出现 hardfault 时输出栈内容，移植阶段是定位问题的重要手段。
L324:   * `CONFIG_INTELHEX_BINARY=y` 与 `CONFIG_RAW_BINARY=y`：编译后同时产出 `.hex` 与 `.bin` 两种烧录格式。
L325: 
L326: ### 7、CPU 特性裁剪（按需调整）
L327: 
L328:     `# CONFIG_ARCH_FPU is not set
L329:     `
L330: #### 说明
L331: 
L332: `CONFIG_ARCH_FPU` 控制硬件浮点单元的启用。Cortex-M4F、M7 等带 FPU 的内核如需使用浮点运算，应改为 `CONFIG_ARCH_FPU=y`。Cortex-M0/M3 无 FPU，保持注释状态即可。
L333: 
L334: ### 8、板级辅助（可选）
L335: 
L336:     `CONFIG_ARCH_BUTTONS=y
L337:     `
L338: 
L339: #### 说明
L340: 
L341: `CONFIG_ARCH_BUTTONS=y`：当板上存在 USER 按钮时启用按钮驱动框架。如目标板无按键，可省略。
L342: ## 三、可直接复用的 defconfig 片段

L393: ## 六、功能验证
L394: 
L395: 子系统启用后，建议通过标准化测试用例验证目标硬件上各子系统的功能完整性。openvela 社区维护了一份面向社区开发者的 xTS 测试用例精简集，覆盖了外设驱动、文件系统、网络、媒体等多个子系统，可作为子系统启用后的功能验收手段。
L396: 
L397: ### 1、推荐使用方式
L398: 
L399:   * L0 启动验证：参赛者按本文最小集完成 NSH 启动后，通过串口手动输入命令（如 `help`、`uname`、`ps`）验证基础 shell 与系统调用工作正常。
L400:   * 子系统功能验证：每启用一个子系统后，从 xTS 测试集中选取该子系统对应的用例运行（如启用 SPI/I2C 驱动后跑 SPI_I2C 测试）。
L401:   * 回归验证：移植稳定后，将整套 xTS 用例作为回归测试集，便于后续配置变更后的功能确认。

L413: ## 七、新硬件适配 Checklist
L414: 
L415: 参赛者完成 BSP 移植后，建议按以下清单检查 defconfig 完整性与目标硬件兼容性：
L416:   * [Input] `CONFIG_ARCH`、`CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP`、`CONFIG_ARCH_BOARD` 三项已替换为目标硬件标识
L417:   * [Input] `CONFIG_RAM_START` 与 `CONFIG_RAM_SIZE` 已按目标芯片 datasheet 填写
L418:   * [Input] 多 SRAM 区芯片（如 STM32F4 含 CCM）已正确设置 `CONFIG_MM_REGIONS`
L419:   * [Input] 串口外设宏（如 `CONFIG_STM32_USART2=y`）已切换至目标芯片对应 UART
L420:   * [Input] `CONFIG_USART<N>_SERIAL_CONSOLE=y` 与 `board.h` 中的引脚定义一致
L421:   * [Input] 串口波特率默认为 115200，与上位机终端一致
L422:   * [Input] `CONFIG_SYSTEM_NSH=y` 与 `CONFIG_INIT_ENTRYPOINT="nsh_main"` 已启用
L423:   * [Input] `CONFIG_DEBUG_SYMBOLS=y` 与 `CONFIG_ARCH_STACKDUMP=y` 已启用，便于排查启动问题
L424:   * [Input] 带 FPU 的内核（M4F/M7）已启用 `CONFIG_ARCH_FPU=y`，无 FPU 的内核（M0/M3）保持关闭
L425:   * [Input] `CONFIG_BOARD_LOOPSPERMSEC` 已根据 CPU 频率设置初始估算值
L426: 通过 Checklist 后即可执行 `./build.sh <vendor>:<config> -j` 编译。烧录后，串口接通并出现 `nsh> ` 提示符即代表 L0 启动成功。

/* CPU interrupt flags.
 * esp_setup_irq() will check bit 1 for IRAM requirement and
 * bit 0 for trigger type.
 *
 * OR'ed values of irq_trigger_e and irq_iram_e define interrupt type.
 *      | IRAM | TRIGGER |
 * Bits |   1  |    0    |
 */

/* CPU interrupt trigger types */

typedef enum irq_trigger_e
{
  ESP_IRQ_TRIGGER_LEVEL    = 0, /* Level-triggered interrupts */
  ESP_IRQ_TRIGGER_EDGE     = 1, /* Edge-triggered interrupts */
} irq_trigger_t;

/* CPU interrupt IRAM enabled */

typedef enum irq_iram_e
{
  ESP_IRQ_NON_IRAM    = (0 << 1), /* Non-IRAM interrupt */
  ESP_IRQ_IRAM        = (1 << 1), /* IRAM interrupt */
} irq_iram_t;

/* CPU interrupt priority levels */

typedef enum irq_priority_e
{
  ESP_IRQ_PRIORITY_1       = 1,                 /* Priority Level 1 */
  ESP_IRQ_PRIORITY_2       = 2,                 /* Priority Level 2 */
  ESP_IRQ_PRIORITY_3       = 3,                 /* Priority Level 3 */
  ESP_IRQ_PRIORITY_4       = 4,                 /* Priority Level 4 */
  ESP_IRQ_PRIORITY_5       = 5,                 /* Priority Level 5 */
  ESP_IRQ_PRIORITY_6       = 6,                 /* Priority Level 6 */
  ESP_IRQ_PRIORITY_7       = 7,                 /* Priority Level 7 */
  ESP_IRQ_PRIORITY_8       = 8,                 /* Priority Level 8 */
  ESP_IRQ_PRIORITY_9       = 9,                 /* Priority Level 9 */
  ESP_IRQ_PRIORITY_10      = 10,                /* Priority Level 10 */
  ESP_IRQ_PRIORITY_11      = 11,                /* Priority Level 11 */
  ESP_IRQ_PRIORITY_12      = 12,                /* Priority Level 12 */
  ESP_IRQ_PRIORITY_13      = 13,                /* Priority Level 13 */
  ESP_IRQ_PRIORITY_14      = 14,                /* Priority Level 14 */
  ESP_IRQ_PRIORITY_15      = 15,                /* Priority Level 15 */
  ESP_IRQ_PRIORITY_DEFAULT = ESP_IRQ_PRIORITY_1 /* Default Priority */
} irq_priority_t;

/****************************************************************************
 * Public Functions Prototypes
 ****************************************************************************/

/****************************************************************************
 * Name: esp_route_intr
 *
 * Description:
 *   Assign an interrupt source to a pre-allocated CPU interrupt.
 *
 * Input Parameters:
 *   source        - Interrupt source (see irq.h) to be assigned to a CPU
 *                   interrupt.
 *   cpuint        - Pre-allocated CPU interrupt to which the interrupt
 *                   source will be assigned.
 *   priority      - Interrupt priority.
 *   type          - Interrupt trigger type.
 *
 * Returned Value:
 *   None.
 *
 ****************************************************************************/

void esp_route_intr(int source, int cpuint, irq_priority_t priority,
                    irq_trigger_t type);

/****************************************************************************
 * Name: esp_setup_irq
 *
 * Description:
 *   This function sets up the IRQ. It allocates a CPU interrupt of the given
 *   priority and type and attaches it to a given interrupt source.
 *
 * Input Parameters:
 *   source        - The interrupt source from irq.h to be assigned to
 *                   a CPU interrupt.
 *   priority      - Interrupt priority.
 *   type          - Interrupt trigger type.
 *
 * Returned Value:
 *   Allocated CPU interrupt.
 *
 ****************************************************************************/

int esp_setup_irq(int source, irq_priority_t priority, int type);

/****************************************************************************
 * Name: esp_teardown_irq
 *
 * Description:
 *   This function undoes the operations done by esp_setup_irq.
 *   It detaches an interrupt source from a CPU interrupt and frees the
 *   CPU interrupt.
 *
 * Input Parameters:
 *   source        - The interrupt source from irq.h to be detached from the
 *                   CPU interrupt.
 *   cpuint        - The CPU interrupt from which the interrupt source will
 *                   be detached.
 *
 * Returned Value:
 *   None.
 *
 ****************************************************************************/

void esp_teardown_irq(int source, int cpuint);

/****************************************************************************
 * Name: esp_intr_noniram_disable
 *
 * Description:
 *   Disable interrupts that aren't specifically marked as running from IRAM.
 *
 * Input Parameters:
 *   None.
 *
 * Returned Value:
 *   None.
 *
 ****************************************************************************/

void esp_intr_noniram_disable(void);

/*************************** Software interrupt dispatcher ***************************/

/** Callback type of the interrupt handler */
typedef void (*intr_handler_t)(void*);

/** Set the interrupt handler function for the given CPU interrupt
 * @param rv_int_num  CPU interrupt number
 * @param fn  Handler function
 * @param arg  Handler argument
 */
void intr_handler_set(int rv_int_num, intr_handler_t fn, void* arg);

/** Get the interrupt handler function for the given CPU interrupt
 *
 *@return interrupt handler registered for a particular interrupt number, or NULL otherwise
 */
intr_handler_t intr_handler_get(int rv_int_num);

/** Get the interrupt handler argument associated with the given CPU interrupt
 *
 *@return interrupt handler argument for a particular interrupt number, or NULL otherwise
 */
void *intr_handler_get_arg(int rv_int_num);

/*************************** ESP-RV Interrupt Controller ***************************/

/**
  * @brief Enable interrupts from interrupt controller.
  *
  * @param uint32_t unmask, unmask bits for interrupts, each bit for an interrupt
  *
  * return none
  */
void esprv_int_enable(uint32_t unmask);

/**
  * @brief Disable interrupts from interrupt controller.
  *
  * @param uint32_t mask, mask bits for interrupts, each bit for an interrupt
  *
  * return none
  */
void esprv_int_disable(uint32_t mask);

/**
 * @brief Set interrupt type
 *
 * Set the type of a particular interrupt (level or edge).
 * - Level interrupts are cleared automatically once their interrupt source has
 *   been cleared
 * - Edge interrupts must be cleared by software when they are handled.
 *
 * @param intr_num Interrupt number
 * @param type Interrupt type
 */
void esprv_int_set_type(int intr_num, enum intr_type type);

/**
 * @brief Get the current type of an interrupt
 *
 * Get the current type of a particular interrupt (level or edge). An interrupt's
 * type can be set by calling esprv_int_set_type().
 *
 * @param intr_num Interrupt number
 * @return Interrupt type
 */
enum intr_type esprv_int_get_type(int intr_num);

/**
 * Set interrupt priority in the interrupt controller
 * @param rv_int_num CPU interrupt number
 * @param priority Interrupt priority level, 1 to 7
 */
void esprv_int_set_priority(int rv_int_num, int priority);

/**
 * @brief Get the current priority of an interrupt
 *
 * Get the current priority of an interrupt.
 *
 * @param rv_int_num CPU interrupt number
 * @return Interrupt priority level, 1 to 7
 */
int esprv_int_get_priority(int rv_int_num);

/**
 * Set interrupt priority threshold.
 * Interrupts with priority levels lower than the threshold are masked.
 *
 * @param priority_threshold  Interrupt priority threshold, 0 to 7
 */
void esprv_int_set_threshold(int priority_threshold);

/**
 * @brief Get interrupt unmask
 * @param none
 * @return uint32_t interrupt unmask
 */
uint32_t esprv_get_interrupt_unmask(void);

/**
 * @brief Check if the given interrupt is hardware vectored
 *
 * @param rv_int_num Interrupt number
 *
 * @return true if the interrupt is vectored, false if it is not.

bool esprv_int_is_vectored(int rv_int_num);

/**

 */
void esprv_int_set_vectored(int rv_int_num, bool vectored);

 * Name: _vector_table

#ifdef CONFIG_SOC_INT_CLIC_SUPPORTED

  /* Non-hardware vectored interrupt entry. MTVEC CSR points here.
   *
   * On targets that use CLIC as their interrupt controller, when an exception occurs, the CPU
   * jumps to the address stored in MTVEC[31:6] << 6. The CPU will also jump to this location
   * if an interrupt is configured as non-vectored (CLIC_INT_ATTR.shv = 0).
   *
   * Because of the left-shift `<< 6`, this entry must be aligned on 64.
   */

  .balign 0x40
  .type     _vector_table, @function

_vector_table:
  j exception_common
  nop

#else /* CONFIG_SOC_INT_PLIC_SUPPORTED */

  /* This is the vector table. MTVEC points here.
   *
   * Use 4-byte instructions here. 1 instruction = 1 entry of the table.
   * The CPU jumps to MTVEC (i.e. the first entry) in case of an exception,
   * and (MTVEC & 0xfffffffc) + (mcause & 0x7fffffff) * 4, in case of an
   * interrupt.
   *
   * Note: for our CPU, we need to place this on a 256-byte boundary, as CPU
   * only uses the 24 MSBs of the MTVEC, i.e. (MTVEC & 0xffffff00).
   */

  .balign 0x100
  .type     _vector_table, @function

_vector_table:

  .rept (32)
  j    exception_common
  .endr

#endif

#    error "CONFIG_RISCV_PERCPU_SCRATCH is needed for handling system calls"
#  endif

#  define EXCEPTION_SECTION .text
#endif

/* Valid exceptions causes range is from 0 to 63 */

#define CAUSE_EXCEPTION   63

/****************************************************************************
 * Name: exception_common
 *
 * Description:
 *   Handles interrupts. If kernel is in S-mode, handles delegated interrupts
 *   in S-mode interrupt handler.
 *
 ****************************************************************************/
